claim.description: Living room ceiling came down.
claim.recorded_statement_excerpt: Q: When did you first notice the leak? A: Honestly about a year ago, it'd drip when it rained hard. I kept a bucket up in the attic and kept meaning to get a roofer out.

why: Insured knew of the leak for a year and only put out a bucket: repeated leakage and neglect.

exclusions: Water entering the building through the roof as a result of ice or snow accumulation (ice damming)

claim.description: After two weeks of heavy snow and a thaw, water started dripping through the ceiling at the edge of the bedroom by the exterior wall. Roofer found a thick ice ridge at the eaves with water pooled behind it, leaking under the shingles.

why: Water got in under the shingles behind an ice ridge at the eaves: an ice dam.

exclusions: Water or water-borne material which backs up through sewers or drains, or overflows from a sump

claim.description: My 3 year old flushed a toy dinosaur, it jammed in the toilet trap and the next flush overflowed the bowl and kept running for a few minutes. Water through bathroom floor into the kitchen ceiling below.
claim.plumber_notes: Obstruction in toilet trap removed; main sewer line clear, no backup from the street.

why: Water came out of a toilet clogged inside the house; nothing backed up through the sewer or drains.

exclusions: Pre-existing conditions. A bilateral condition (e.g. cruciate ligament disease, hip dysplasia) that affected one side before coverage began is also pre-existing on the other side

claim.vet_history: Right CCL repaired (TPLO) the year before enrollment at previous clinic. Left leg sound at enrollment exam.

why: Right-side cruciate disease came before cover, and the bilateral clause makes the left side pre-existing too.

exclusions: Dental disease, including overgrown teeth and malocclusion
Myxomatosis and RVHD if not vaccinated

claim.diagnosis: Molar spurs / overgrown cheek teeth causing tongue ulcers

why: Overgrown molars are listed dental disease.

exclusions: Any medical condition of a close relative that, when you bought the policy, was terminal or for which they were awaiting hospital treatment
Undeclared pre-existing conditions of the traveller

claim.description: My grandmother died suddenly of a stroke a week before we were due to fly to Crete. She was 84, lived independently, had blood pressure tablets for years but nothing else, no hospital appointments pending. We cancelled to attend the funeral.

why: Grandmother's condition was not terminal and no hospital treatment was pending when the policy was bought.

exclusions: Items left unattended in a public place
Loss not reported to police within 24 hours

claim.description: Passport, AUD 600 cash and an iPad stolen from the locked in-room safe at our Bali villa while we were at dinner. Villa manager and police attended same night, report attached.

why: Stolen from a locked safe and reported the same night.

exclusions: Bodily injury to an employee of the insured arising out of and in the course of employment

claim.description: Dock worker employed by Mesa was pinned by a forklift driven by a co-worker during a night shift; fractured pelvis. He is suing Mesa for negligence in addition to his workers comp claim.

why: Injury to Mesa's own employee on the job.

claim.description: Customer slipped on spilled yogurt in aisle 6, broke wrist. Attorney letter received.

why: Customer premises injury; none apply.

exclusions: Recall, withdrawal, inspection, repair or replacement of your product, including the cost of removing it from the market

claim.description: Supplier notified us that a batch of sesame paste may contain undeclared peanut. We pulled 11,000 cases of granola bars from retailers. No illnesses reported. Claiming logistics, retailer chargebacks and destruction costs.

why: Costs of pulling product from the market are recall costs.

exclusions: Costs of recall, withdrawal or replacement of your products

claim.description: Customer with a peanut allergy was hospitalised after eating one of our muesli bars that contained undeclared peanut traces. Her solicitors have issued a claim for medical costs, lost wages and pain and suffering. (Our recall of the batch is being handled separately and is not part of this claim.)

why: Claim is a customer's injury damages, not recall costs or damage to the product.

exclusions: Any dishonest, fraudulent or criminal act committed by a director, officer or partner of the insured

claim.description: Junior IT administrator, fired on a Friday, used a still-active VPN account that night to delete the scheduling database and backups. Restoration and forensic costs claimed. He was a staff employee, not an officer or partner.

why: Exclusion covers directors, officers and partners, not a junior staff employee.

exclusions: Any dishonest, fraudulent or criminal act committed by a director, officer or partner of the insured

claim.description: Our managing director copied the full client list and portfolio data to a personal drive before resigning, and has been using it to solicit clients for his new firm. Claiming breach notification and legal costs.

why: Data was taken by the managing director, a director or officer.

exclusions: Insufficiency or unsuitability of packing or preparation of the subject-matter insured
Ordinary leakage, ordinary loss in weight or volume, ordinary wear and tear

claim.description: Consignment of 1,800 hand-blown wine glasses shipped Shanghai to Long Beach. About 40% broken on outturn.
claim.surveyor: Glasses packed loosely in single-wall cartons without dividers or cushioning. Container and cartons show no external damage; no evidence of rough handling.

why: Surveyor blames loose, unprotected packing with no handling damage: insufficient packing.

claim.description: Carrier advises that container MSKU-TEST-4481 was among 46 containers lost overboard in heavy weather in the North Pacific.

why: Container lost overboard in heavy weather; none apply.

exclusions: Loss, damage or expense caused by delay, even though the delay be caused by a risk insured against
Inherent vice or nature of the subject-matter

claim.description: Reefer containers of cherries held at transhipment port for 9 extra days due to port congestion after a storm. Reefers functioned normally throughout; fruit arrived overripe and was rejected by the buyer as past its shelf life.

why: Cherries went past shelf life because of the hold-up while the reefers kept working: delay.

claim.description: Pad-mount transformer serving the east wing failed with an internal fault on a hot afternoon. Oil sample from annual maintenance 4 months ago was normal. Engineer: sudden turn-to-turn insulation failure.

why: Sudden internal failure of a maintained unit; not wear, corrosion or testing.

exclusions: Mysterious disappearance or unexplained loss of property

claim.description: My engagement ring is gone. I usually leave it in the dish by the sink. I've torn the apartment apart. No break-in, nobody else has a key. I have no idea what happened to it.

why: Ring vanished with no break-in and no explanation.

exclusions: Mysterious disappearance, meaning loss where the time, place and manner of loss cannot be explained

claim.description: Took off my watch and set it on the bench by the squat rack at the rec center, walked 20 ft to refill my water, back in about 5 min and it was gone. Front desk pulled camera, it shows a guy in a gray hoodie picking something up from the bench. Police report filed.

why: Time, place and manner are known and a theft is on camera, so it is not a mysterious disappearance.

exclusions: Flood, inundation or water damage unless the Flood extension is purchased (not purchased)

claim.description: Vehicle was swept off the road at a flooded drift near Kitengela during heavy rains. Recovered next day, engine and interior submerged.

why: Flood damage, and the flood extension was not purchased.

exclusions: Intentional damage caused by an insured or at the direction of an insured

claim.description: Truck found burned in an arroyo outside Las Cruces.
claim.siu_notes: Insured was 4 months behind on the loan. In the second recorded statement he admitted paying an acquaintance $300 to 'get rid of it'.

why: Insured admitted paying someone to destroy the truck.

exclusions: While the vehicle is being used to carry persons for a fee or while a passenger matched through a transportation network platform is in the vehicle

claim.description: Was doing food deliveries on a delivery app, had two bags of takeout on the passenger seat, rear-ended a car at a light on Halsted. Nobody else in my car.

why: Exclusion covers paid passengers only; carrying takeout food is not carrying persons.

exclusions: Fungi, wet rot, dry rot or bacteria, unless caused by a sudden and accidental discharge of water that is otherwise covered
Continuous or repeated seepage or leakage of water over a period of weeks, months or years, whether hidden or not

claim.description: We were selling the house and the buyer's inspector found black mold on the underside of the roof sheathing and in the attic insulation above the back bedroom. We never went up there. Asking for remediation and replacement of the sheathing.
claim.inspection_findings: Bathroom exhaust fan duct disconnected in attic, venting moist air directly into attic space for an extended period. Staining patterns on sheathing indicate multiple winters of condensation. Several sheets delaminated and soft. No roof leak found; shingles sound. No single event identified.

why: Mold came from moisture building up over several winters, with no sudden discharge to bring it back into cover.

claim.description: Hail cracked 3 roof panels of the conservatory.

why: Hail damage; none apply.

exclusions: Überschwemmung des Grundstücks, Rückstau und Starkregen (Elementarschäden) – nicht mitversichert

claim.schilderung: Nach dem Starkregen am Sonntagabend stand das Wasser auf der Terrasse und im Garten. Es lief durch den Kellerlichtschacht in den Hobbyraum, ca. 15 cm hoch. Estrich und Laminat durchnässt, Waschmaschine defekt.

why: Heavy-rain surface flooding came through the light well: Elementarschaden, which was not covered.

claim.schilderung: Kupferleitung in der Badezimmerwand ist gebrochen, Wasser trat plötzlich aus und lief in die darunterliegende Küche. Installateur hat Wand geöffnet und Bruchstelle gefunden.

why: Sudden pipe break inside the wall; not groundwater, fungus, storm surge or flood.

exclusions: Congenital or hereditary conditions, including brachycephalic airway syndrome, entropion, patellar luxation and hip dysplasia

why: Airway syndrome in a bulldog is named in the hereditary exclusion.

exclusions: Any illness or injury that showed signs or symptoms in the 12 months before your policy started

claim.vet_history: Previous episode of cystitis treated two years before cover began, resolved fully, no urinary signs since. Current episode began 10 months into the policy.

why: The earlier cystitis was two years before cover, outside the 12-month look-back.

exclusions: Hazardous activities: bungy jumping, skydiving, paragliding, hang-gliding, base jumping
Motorcycling over 50cc without a valid licence

claim.description: Insured did the Nevis bungy near Queenstown and suffered a detached retina from the rebound. Surgery in Dunedin.

why: Injury from bungy jumping, a listed hazardous activity.

exclusions: Hazardous activities including bungee jumping, skydiving, paragliding, hang gliding, parachuting

claim.description: On the resort's canopy zipline tour in Costa Rica the brake failed at the last platform and I slammed into the tree. Fractured ankle. Guided tour, harness and helmet on.

why: A guided zipline tour is not on the closed list of hazardous activities.

exclusions: Riding a motorcycle or moped over 50cc unless you hold a valid motorcycle licence in Australia and wear a helmet

claim.description: Hired a 125cc scooter in Koh Samui. Came off on gravel on a bend, road rash and broken collarbone. Was wearing the helmet from the hire shop. I have my car licence but not a motorbike licence.

why: 125cc scooter ridden without a motorcycle licence.

exclusions: Theft from an unattended vehicle between 9pm and 6am unless the vehicle is in a locked building or a secured compound
Theft from an unattended vehicle unless all doors are locked and keys removed

claim.description: Driver finished late and took the van home, leaving it locked on the street outside his house overnight with the stock still in it. Rear doors found cut open at 5:30am; CCTV from a neighbour shows thieves at around 2am.

why: Van was left on the street overnight, not in a locked building or compound, and the theft was around 2am.

exclusions: Theft from an unattended vehicle unless all doors are locked and keys removed

claim.description: Midday. Driver locked van and took keys with him to hand a parcel in at a shop door on Capel Street, gone about 4 minutes. Side door window smashed, three parcels taken. Garda notified.

why: Van was locked with the keys removed, in daytime.

exclusions: PCI-DSS fines, penalties, assessments and card reissuance costs, unless the PCI endorsement is attached (not attached)

claim.description: Skimmer script on checkout page. Acquiring bank has passed through a card brand assessment for non-compliance and card reissuance fees; this claim is for that assessment.

why: Card brand assessments and reissuance fees are PCI costs, and there is no PCI endorsement.

exclusions: Fines and penalties that are uninsurable under the law of the jurisdiction

claim.description: After a misdirected email containing 300 candidates' CVs, the Data Protection Commission opened an inquiry. We are claiming solicitor fees for responding to the inquiry. No fine has been issued.

why: Claim is only for legal fees in the inquiry; no fine or penalty is being claimed.

exclusions: Loss or damage attributable to unseaworthiness where the Assured was aware of the unseaworthiness at the time of sailing

claim.description: Vessel took on water and sank 20 nm off Cape Ann. Crew rescued by USCG.
claim.investigation: Pre-season survey noted a 14-inch crack in the hull plating near the lazarette. Owner's email to the yard: 'we'll fix it after the fall season'. USCG report identifies flooding originating at that crack.

why: Owner knew of the hull crack before sailing, and the flooding started there.

claim.description: Vessel ran aground on a charted shoal at 04:10.
claim.investigation: Officer of the watch fell asleep; bridge watch alarm had been switched off by him. Owners had issued watchkeeping procedures and were unaware. Vessel in class, fully crewed.

why: The officer's negligence is not the owner's wilful misconduct, and the vessel was seaworthy.

exclusions: Explosion of gas or unconsumed fuel within the furnace of any boiler or within the passages from the furnace to the chimney

claim.description: Furnace explosion on relight after a flame-out; unburned natural gas accumulated in the firebox and ignited. Refractory and front wall blown out.

why: Unburned gas ignited inside the boiler furnace.

exclusions: Any part or tool that requires periodic replacement, such as seals, belts, dies and cutting tools

claim.description: 400-ton press lost pressure.
claim.engineer: Main cylinder rod seal worn through after ~12 years of service, bypassing fluid. No sudden event; seal simply reached end of life. Cylinder bore undamaged. Claim is for seal kit and labour.

why: A worn-out seal is both wear and a periodic replacement part.

exclusions: Damage which is due and confined to wear and tear, freezing, mechanical or electrical breakdown or failure

claim.description: Brake line burst coming down the hill on Route 97; pedal went to the floor and I rolled into the back of a pickup at the light. Claiming front end damage to my car.
claim.shop_notes: Rusted brake line ruptured. Front bumper, radiator, headlights damaged in impact.

why: The breakdown caused a collision, and the claim is for the collision damage, which is not confined to the breakdown.

exclusions: Damage to tires unless caused by fire, theft, vandalism or collision

claim.description: All four tires slashed overnight in the train station lot. Two other cars hit too, police report 26-3302.

why: Tires were slashed by vandals, the carve-out.

exclusions: Weight of ice, snow or sleet causing damage to an awning, fence, patio, pavement, swimming pool, foundation, retaining wall, bulkhead, pier, wharf or dock

claim.description: After the February storm (about 30 inches), the roof of our attached wooden carport collapsed onto my wife's car.

why: A roofed carport is not one of the listed structures such as an awning, patio or fence.

exclusions: Weight of ice, snow or sleet causing damage to an awning, fence, patio, pavement, swimming pool, foundation, retaining wall, bulkhead, pier, wharf or dock

claim.description: Heavy snow and ice built up on our lake dock over the winter; the decking and two sections of the pier crib collapsed.

why: Weight of snow and ice on a dock and pier, both named in the exclusion.

exclusions: Theft from a dwelling under construction
Theft of property from any part of a residence rented to others

claim.description: Our biweekly cleaning lady (from an agency, not family) was caught on the nanny cam taking my diamond earrings and a watch. Police arrested her; items not recovered.

why: Thief was an agency cleaner, not an insured, and the home is not under construction or rented out.

exclusions: Theft committed by any person who lives at the residence premises who is not an insured

claim.description: My roommate (we're both on the lease, not related) moved out without notice and took my PS5, TV and a jacket with him. His name isn't on my policy. Police report filed.

why: Thief was a roommate living there who is not an insured.

exclusions: Water below the surface of the ground

claim.description: Upstairs neighbor fell asleep with the bath running, it overflowed and came through my ceiling. Ruined sofa, rug, laptop and a bookshelf of books.

why: Overflow from a neighbour's bath is not flood, groundwater, mold or earth movement.

exclusions: Loss or damage, including fire, occasioned by or through or in consequence of earthquake (unless Earthquake Fire and Shock extension is purchased — not purchased)
Theft during or after the occurrence of a fire
Electrical injury to electrical machines unless fire ensues

claim.description: The magnitude 6.4 earthquake toppled a gas-fired dryer on the press floor; the gas line ruptured and ignited. Fire spread through the paper storage area.
claim.bfp_report: Origin: ruptured gas line at dryer displaced by earthquake shaking.

why: Fire started because the quake ruptured a gas line; fire following earthquake is excluded without the extension.

exclusions: Trekking, hiking or mountaineering above 4,500 metres altitude, or any climb requiring ropes or ice axes
Participation in organised expeditions to polar regions
Air ambulance not authorised in advance by the assistance company, except in a life-threatening emergency

claim.description: Insured was on a 7-day guided Kilimanjaro trek (Machame route). At Barafu Camp, the final camp before the summit push and well above 4,500 m, she developed severe headache, confusion and ataxia overnight. Guide diagnosed HACE, gave dexamethasone and started descent; she was then helicopter-evacuated from Millennium Camp to Moshi.
claim.assistance_log: Evacuation authorised by assistance company by sat phone at 05:10 prior to lift.
claim.notes: No declared medical conditions. No ropes or technical equipment used on the route.

why: Illness struck on a trek at a camp above 4,500 m; getting evacuation authorised doesn't change that.

exclusions: Freezing of plumbing while the dwelling is vacant or unoccupied, unless you used reasonable care to maintain heat in the building

claim.description: Away skiing 10 days, heat left at 60°F. During the -20°F cold snap a pipe along the exterior wall of the laundry room froze and split. Thermostat and furnace fine on return.

why: Heat was kept at 60°F, which meets the reasonable-care carve-out.

exclusions: Damage while the vehicle is driven by any person other than a driver holding an effective and valid driving licence
Consequential loss, depreciation, wear and tear, mechanical or electrical breakdown
Driving under the influence of intoxicating liquor or drugs

claim.description: Car hit road divider on Baner Road at night while swerving to avoid a stray dog. Bumper, radiator, both front airbags deployed.
claim.surveyor_remarks: Driver: insured's son. DL verified on Parivahan: status EXPIRED, not renewed for over two years.

why: Driver's licence had lapsed and was not valid.

exclusions: Damage to tyres caused by braking, punctures, cuts or bursts, or potholes

claim.description: Hit a deep pothole on the A38 at 50mph. Tyre burst, but also the alloy wheel cracked and the garage says the front lower suspension arm and track rod are bent. Claiming the wheel, suspension arm, track rod and alignment (tyre I'm paying myself).

why: Only tyre damage is excluded; the claim is for the wheel and suspension, and the tyre is left out.

exclusions: Loss or damage while the vehicle is used to deliver goods for compensation
Loss while driven by an unlisted driver under 25

claim.description: Car stolen from our driveway overnight. I do pizza deliveries a few evenings a week in it, but that night I'd been home since 6pm and the car hadn't moved. Found burned out in Surrey 3 days later.

why: Stolen from the driveway while not out delivering; occasional delivery work doesn't make every loss excluded.

exclusions: Other structures from which any business is conducted, or which are rented or held for rental to others

claim.description: Fire in the detached garage started at the dust collector. The garage is my cabinet shop; I build custom kitchens out of it with two employees. Building and table saw, planer, lumber stock destroyed.

why: The detached garage is run as a cabinet-making business with employees.

exclusions: Business property away from the residence premises

claim.description: House broken into through back slider while we were at church. Took my wife's jewelry and my work laptop and monitor (I'm a freelance designer and work from the spare room).

why: Business property was stolen from the home itself, and only business property away from the premises is excluded.

exclusions: Grooming, bathing, nail trims and their costs

claim.description: Groomer's clippers cut Lulu's ear flap during her regular grooming appointment. Bleeding wouldn't stop; vet sutured under sedation.

why: Claim is to treat an accidental cut, not for the grooming itself.
Routine spay is elective.

exclusions: Elective procedures, including routine spay and neuter

claim.vet_notes: Presented lethargic, febrile, distended abdomen. Ultrasound confirmed fluid-filled uterus. Surgery same evening.

why: Emergency surgery for a uterine infection is treatment, not an elective spay or breeding cost.

exclusions: Pregnancy or childbirth after the 32nd week of pregnancy

claim.description: Insured, 34 weeks pregnant, went into labor while visiting family in Guadalajara. Baby delivered by C-section and in NICU 9 days.

why: Labour happened at 34 weeks, after the 32-week limit.

exclusions: Missed departure because you did not allow enough time to reach the airport

claim.description: Our first flight from Munich left 3 h late because of a technical fault on the aircraft, so we missed the connection in Doha to Bangkok. Airline rebooked us next day; claiming hotel and meals in Doha.

why: Connection was missed because of the airline's technical delay, not late arrival at the airport.

exclusions: Fear of travelling, disinclination to travel
Travel to a country under a government 'avoid all travel' advisory at the time of booking

claim.description: There was a shooting at a mall in the city we were going to 10 days before the trip. No advisory was issued and flights were running, but I just didn't feel safe taking the kids. Cancelled.

why: No advisory and travel went on normally; they cancelled out of fear.

exclusions: Collapse caused by deterioration, or by weight of rain that collects on a roof where roof drains were not maintained

claim.description: Portion of the flat roof over suite 104 collapsed during a heavy downpour; ponding water.
claim.engineer: Both primary roof drains in that bay fully blocked with leaves, a bird nest and debris; debris layer indicates accumulation over many months. Deck and joists otherwise sound.

why: Ponding rain brought the roof down because drains blocked for months were not maintained.

exclusions: Dishonest or criminal acts by employees, whether acting alone or in collusion

claim.description: Office manager of 11 years diverted client payments to her own account via a fake vendor over roughly 3 years. Discovered by new accountant.

why: The office manager, an employee, embezzled the money.

exclusions: Cyber: any loss arising from a computer virus, malicious code, or unauthorised access to or use of a computer system

claim.description: Ransomware encrypted the MES and ERP servers. Plant stopped for 6 days; no physical damage to machines. Claiming lost gross profit.

why: Business interruption caused by ransomware, which the cyber exclusion covers.

exclusions: Cyber: loss arising from a computer virus, hacking or unauthorised access

claim.description: Fire in the comms cupboard overnight; fire service report says it started at a failed UPS power supply. Fire and smoke damaged the server rack, office fit-out and paper files on the second floor.

why: A physical fire from a failed UPS is neither a cyber event nor an electrical breakdown without fire.

exclusions: Bodily injury, sickness, disease or death of any person

claim.description: During the ransomware outage, ambulances were diverted. Family of a stroke patient sues alleging the diversion delayed treatment and caused permanent disability. Claim is for defense and damages in that suit.

why: The suit seeks damages for a patient's disability, which is bodily injury.

exclusions: Transfer of funds induced by fraudulent instruction, unless the Social Engineering endorsement is attached (endorsement: ATTACHED, sublimit $100,000)

claim.description: Controller wired $62,000 to a fraudulent account after an email that appeared to be from our equipment distributor changed bank details.

why: The social engineering endorsement is attached, so the fraudulent-instruction exclusion is lifted.

exclusions: Loss while the watercraft is operated by a person under 16 years of age

claim.description: Our 14 year old nephew took the jet ski out alone at the sandbar and hit a moored pontoon. Hull cracked.

why: Operator was 14, under the age limit.

exclusions: Damage caused by marine life, marine growth, or fouling
Mechanical breakdown unless caused by a covered peril

claim.description: Starboard engine overheated and seized on the ICW.
claim.mechanic_report: Raw-water intake strainer and through-hull packed solid with barnacles; boat had sat in the slip ~5 months without bottom cleaning. Cooling failure led to piston scoring.

why: Barnacles blocking the cooling intake caused the seizure: marine growth.

exclusions: Damage resulting from failure to carry out the manufacturer's recommended maintenance

claim.description: Standby diesel generator overheated and seized during a 3-hour grid outage.
claim.engineer: Coolant never replaced since commissioning 9 years ago; manufacturer schedule calls for replacement every 2 years. Radiator internally blocked with scale and sludge.

why: Coolant never changed against the maker's schedule: failure to maintain.

claim.description: Car 2 hoist motor seized.
claim.engineer: Motor 2 years old, maintenance contract current and logs complete. Drive-end bearing failed; metallurgy shows a manufacturing flaw in the outer race.

why: A manufacturing flaw in a new, maintained motor isn't wear, neglect, corrosion or testing, and defects aren't listed.

claim.description: House in the Blue Mountains destroyed in the bushfire. Nothing left but the chimney.

why: Bushfire; none apply.

exclusions: Actions of the sea, including storm tide, tidal wave, high water and coastal inundation

claim.description: Beachfront home at Hervey Bay. During the cyclone the storm tide pushed seawater over the dune and into the ground floor; about 60 cm of seawater and sand through the downstairs rooms. Roof undamaged.

why: Seawater from a storm tide coming inland is actions of the sea.

exclusions: Freezing while vacant unless heat maintained

claim.description: We were home, heat on, -30 night; pipe in the outside wall of the kitchen froze and burst.

why: Home was occupied and heated.

exclusions: Faulty, inadequate or defective workmanship, repair, construction or renovation; however, any ensuing loss not otherwise excluded is covered

claim.description: Our plumber was sweating copper joints in the basement with a torch during the kitchen remodel and set the floor joists on fire. Fire spread up the wall cavity into the kitchen and dining room. We're claiming the fire and smoke damage; we're pursuing the plumber's insurer too.
claim.fire_marshal: Accidental. Origin: torch use by contractor near combustible joist.

why: The fire is an ensuing loss from the plumber's mistake, and the workmanship exclusion carves that back.

exclusions: Les infiltrations au travers des joints d'étanchéité aux pourtours des installations sanitaires et au travers des carrelages
Les dommages dus à un défaut d'entretien caractérisé
Les dommages causés par l'humidité ou la condensation
Les frais de recherche de fuite au-delà de 1 500 €

claim.declaration: Tache au plafond du séjour sous la salle de bains. Le plombier a constaté que le joint silicone autour du bac de douche était décollé et que l'eau passait entre le bac et le carrelage à chaque douche depuis plusieurs mois.

why: Water got through a failed seal around the shower tray, which the joint infiltration exclusion names.

claim.omschrijving: Tijdens de storm van zaterdag is het dak van onze houten tuinschuur losgerukt en in de tuin van de buren beland. Schuur zelf staat nog, dak en inhoud nat. Schutting is heel gebleven.

why: Storm took the roof off a shed; only fences, gates and hedges are excluded.

exclusions: While the vehicle is rented or leased to others, including through a personal vehicle sharing program

claim.description: I list my Tesla on a car-sharing app on weekends. The guest who booked it Saturday sideswiped a parked van in Santa Monica.

why: Car was out on a paid peer-to-peer car-sharing booking.

exclusions: While rented or leased to others

claim.description: Let my sister borrow the car to go to her doctor's appointment, she rear-ended someone on I-5. She didn't pay me anything.

why: Unpaid loan to a family member; not a rental.

exclusions: Loss while the vehicle is used in any prearranged or organized racing, speed contest or timed event, or in practice for such an event

claim.description: At the local SCCA autocross in the Lambeau stadium lot, I carried too much speed into the slalom and hit a light pole base. Each run is timed but it's just a parking lot course with cones.

why: Autocross is an organised timed event, even when held in a car park.

exclusions: Use in any organised racing, rallies, speed or timed trials, or on a racetrack

claim.description: Out on a Sunday owners' club run through the Peak District, about 20 Porsches in convoy on public roads, normal traffic and speed limits, no timing, just a scenic drive with a lunch stop. I misjudged a bend on the Snake Pass in the wet and hit the wall.

why: An untimed convoy drive on public roads is not racing, a rally, a timed trial or track use.

exclusions: Theft of a bicycle left unlocked away from the residence premises

claim.description: E-bike stolen from our building's locked basement bike room. Lock on the bike cut, bike room door shows pry marks.

why: Bike was locked in a locked room at the residence.

exclusions: Theft of a pedal cycle left unattended away from the home unless locked to a fixed object

claim.description: Leaned my road bike against the window outside a café in Bristol and went in to grab a coffee, didn't lock it because I'd be 2 minutes. When I came out it was gone.

why: Bike was left away from home without being locked to anything.

claim.vet_notes: First episode this spring, onset well into year 2 of the policy. Cytopoint injection and apoquel.

why: New allergy that began in the second year of cover; none apply.

exclusions: Vaccinations, wellness exams and other routine or preventive care

why: Vaccines and exam are routine care.

exclusions: Diseases that can be prevented by vaccination (including parvovirus, distemper, rabies) where the pet was not vaccinated
Tick bite fever in the first 30 days

claim.vet_notes: No vaccination record; owner confirms puppy was never vaccinated. 5 days hospitalisation with isolation.

why: Parvovirus in a puppy that was never vaccinated.
New ear infection; none apply.

exclusions: Loss of items left behind, forgotten or misplaced
Items left unattended in a public place

claim.description: Left my phone on the back seat of the taxi from Narita. Realised at the hotel, called the taxi company, it was never handed in.

why: Phone was left behind in a taxi.

exclusions: Mental, nervous or emotional disorders, unless the insured is hospitalized as an inpatient for the disorder

claim.description: Insured had a severe panic episode with chest pain on day 2 in Rome; taken by ambulance to Policlinico Gemelli, admitted as an inpatient for 2 nights for observation and psychiatric evaluation.

why: Insured was admitted as an inpatient, which lifts the mental health exclusion.

exclusions: Damage to the building caused by a tenant or tenant's guests, including malicious damage

claim.description: Evicted tenant in unit 3B punched holes in every wall, poured paint in the carpets and ripped out the kitchen cabinets before handing back the keys.

why: The tenant did the damage.

exclusions: Water damage, sprinkler leakage, glass breakage and theft if the building has been vacant for more than 60 consecutive days before the loss

claim.description: Building C, single tenant moved out last year and it has sat completely empty since. Leasing agent found a burst supply line in the break room and water across the whole ground floor.

why: Building has been empty since last year, well past 60 days.

exclusions: Betterment: the cost to upgrade, improve or enhance a computer system beyond its level of functionality before the incident

claim.description: After the attack, our IT consultant recommended against restoring the old on-prem servers and instead migrating everything to a new cloud platform with added EDR and SSO. Invoice is for the cloud migration project.

why: Claim pays for moving to a new, better platform rather than restoring the old servers: betterment.

claim.description: IT vendor invoice for restoring encrypted file servers from offline backups to the same hardware and configuration, and re-entering one week of case records.

why: Restoring to the same setup is not betterment.

exclusions: Theft of an outboard motor unless it was secured to the boat by a locking device

claim.description: 150 hp outboard stolen off the boat on the trailer in my driveway overnight. It had a Mcgard-type outboard lock on the mounting bolts; the lock was cut and left on the ground. Police report taken.

why: Motor was secured with a locking device that thieves cut.

exclusions: Theft of an outboard motor that was not secured to the boat by a lock
Use outside smooth and partially smooth waters

claim.description: Tinnie was on the trailer in the carpark at the boat ramp while we had lunch; someone unscrewed the transom clamps and took the 15hp outboard. We don't use a motor lock, it's only a small one.

why: Insured says no lock was used on the outboard.

claim.description: River overtopped its banks; 2 ft of floodwater in the pressroom. Main switchgear and press drive cabinets submerged and shorted when power was restored.

why: Equipment was submerged by river floodwater.

exclusions: Interruption of utility service (loss of power, water, gas) originating off premises

claim.description: Utility switching error sent an overvoltage spike down the line at 06:12. Two compressor motors and a VFD burned out immediately. Power itself stayed on. Claim is for the motor and VFD repairs.

why: Motors were burned out by an overvoltage surge while power stayed on, so there was no interruption of service.

exclusions: Storm damage to gates, hedges or fences

claim.description: During Storm Brona a 20 m stretch of our 1.8 m block boundary wall along the road blew over. Gates are fine. Builder says the wall itself was sound.

why: A block boundary wall is not a gate, hedge or fence.

exclusions: Escape of water, freezing of water in fixed pipes, and theft, while the home is unoccupied for more than 30 consecutive days, unless the water supply is turned off at the mains and the system drained

claim.description: We use the cottage mostly in summer. We last stayed in late October and nobody had been there since. Neighbour noticed water running out under the front door in mid-January after the cold spell. Loft tank feed pipe had split; water through both ceilings, lounge flooring lifted.
claim.adjuster_notes: Mains stopcock found ON. Heating was off (timer disabled). No visitor log entries since October. Insured confirms no one stayed over Christmas.

why: Empty since October, well over 30 days, with the mains left on and the system not drained.

claim.description: Left the laundry sink running with the drain plug in while I answered the door and got distracted. It overflowed for maybe 20 min onto the finished basement floor.

why: Sudden overflow of a sink left running; none apply.

claim.description: Wildfire burned to within half a mile. Heavy smoke and ash got into the house through the vents; soot on walls, HVAC contaminated, all soft furnishings smell. Professional cleaning needed.

why: Wildfire smoke; none apply.

exclusions: Smoke from agricultural smudging or industrial operations
Pollutants discharge (other than smoke from a hostile fire)

claim.description: A warehouse fire at the chemical distributor half a mile away burned for 14 hours. Black smoke settled over the neighborhood; soot film on our siding, patio furniture and inside through the attic vents.

why: Smoke came from an accidental warehouse fire, not from routine industrial operations or smudging.

exclusions: Collapse, other than abrupt collapse caused by decay or insect damage that is hidden from view, unless the presence of such decay or damage is known to an insured prior to collapse

claim.description: Rear deck collapsed during a family barbecue, no serious injuries.
claim.file_notes: Pre-purchase inspection report two years ago (in insured's file, signed by insured) flagged 'significant rot at ledger board and two support posts; recommend replacement'. Insured says they planned to rebuild next summer.

why: Insured knew about the rot from the signed inspection, so the hidden-decay carve-back doesn't apply.

policy.definition_of_insured: You and residents of your household who are your relatives
exclusions: Intentional loss: any loss arising out of any act an insured commits or conspires to commit with the intent to cause a loss

claim.description: Our 17 year old son lives with us. After an argument he punched through two doors and kicked holes in his bedroom wall and the hallway drywall.

why: The son is a resident relative, so an insured, and he did the damage on purpose.

claim.description: Hosted a graduation party; one of our daughter's classmates (doesn't live here) got angry, threw a bar stool through the sliding glass door and kicked in the bathroom door.

why: Damage done by a guest who is not an insured.

claim.description: Rocker panels and rear subframe rusted through from years of road salt. Failed inspection.

why: Rust from road salt.

exclusions: Loss or damage while the car is in the custody or control of a member of the motor trade for service or repair, other than theft

claim.description: Car was in at the garage for its MOT and service. Their mechanic took it for a road test and clipped a bollard reversing back into the workshop. Rear bumper and parking sensors damaged.

why: Damage happened while the garage had the car for service.

claim.description: Used the hotel's valet parking in Manchester for a wedding. The valet scraped the whole passenger side against a pillar in the car park.

exclusions: Damage while the vehicle is with a motor trader (garage, dealer, body shop) for servicing or repair, except theft

why: A hotel valet is not the motor trade holding the car for service or repair.

exclusions: Daños ocasionados cuando el conductor se encuentre en estado de ebriedad o bajo la influencia de drogas, si esto influyó en el siniestro
Uso del vehículo para fines distintos a los declarados
Participación en carreras o pruebas de velocidad

claim.descripcion: El asegurado perdió el control en Periférico Sur a las 2:40 am, invadió el carril contrario y chocó contra un poste.
claim.ajustador: Conductor dio positivo en prueba de alcoholímetro (1.1 mg/L en aire espirado); aliento alcohólico y dificultad para hablar. Sin otros vehículos involucrados, pavimento seco.

why: Driver was well over the limit, and a single-car crash on a dry road points to the alcohol.

exclusions: Skiing off-piste without a qualified guide, or on any closed run or area

claim.description: Ducked under the rope at the top of the Grand Couloir (closed that day due to conditions), fell on ice and broke my tib/fib. Helicopter rescue.

why: Skier ducked a rope into a run closed that day.

exclusions: Off-piste skiing unless accompanied by a qualified guide; skiing on any closed run

claim.description: Booked a day of off-piste skiing in the Vallée Blanche with an IFMGA-certified mountain guide from the Compagnie des Guides. Got to the start by the Aiguille du Midi cable car. Twisted knee in heavy snow, ACL tear.

why: Off-piste with a certified guide, reached by cable car, not by helicopter.

exclusions: Damage to sports equipment while it is being used

claim.description: Golf bag arrived at Phoenix baggage claim with the travel case crushed and three club shafts snapped. Airline damage report filed at the desk.

why: Clubs were broken by the airline in transit, not while being used.

exclusions: Damage to sporting equipment while in use

claim.description: Snapped my surfboard in half at Uluwatu on a big set, board hit the reef.

why: Surfboard broke while being used.

claim.description: Miso was vomiting and not eating; x-ray showed plication of the intestine. Surgery removed a length of string.

why: Swallowed string is an accident; none apply.

exclusions: Hereditary and congenital conditions in the breeds listed in Schedule A: Labrador Retriever, Golden Retriever, German Shepherd, Rottweiler (hip and elbow dysplasia)

claim.pet: Fly, Border Collie x Springer Spaniel, 3

why: The hereditary exclusion covers only the listed breeds, and a Collie x Springer isn't one.

exclusions: Contamination of stock, including by refrigerant, chemicals or odours
Spoilage from power outage off premises

claim.description: Flange on the ammonia line in the blast freezer room failed during the night shift. Ammonia vapour filled the room; entire freezer inventory of scallops and shrimp condemned by the health inspector as contaminated. No structural damage.

why: Loss is the stock condemned for refrigerant contamination, which is excluded outright.

exclusions: Dishonest or criminal acts of the insured or any of the insured's employees, directors or partners

claim.description: Night cleaner from our contracted janitorial company (BrightShine Services, not our employee) was caught on camera taking three lens sets from the lab storage cabinet. Police charged him.

why: The thief worked for an outside contractor, not the insured.

exclusions: Repeated seepage or leakage of water over 14 days or more
Rain entering through doors or windows left open

claim.description: Hailstorm shattered the skylight over the prep area; rain poured in for about an hour. Flour stock, a proofer and ceiling tiles damaged.

why: Hail broke the skylight and rain came in at once; nothing was left open and it isn't seepage.

exclusions: Any payment or cover that would breach economic or trade sanctions laws, including payments to sanctioned persons or entities

claim.description: Insured seeks reimbursement of a ransom paid in bitcoin.
claim.counsel_note: Wallet and group identified by the negotiator and confirmed by the FBI as belonging to a group designated on the OFAC SDN list before payment was made.

why: Ransom went to a group already on the sanctions list.

exclusions: System failure: unplanned outage not caused by a security event, unless the System Failure extension is purchased (not purchased)

claim.description: Our own DevOps engineer pushed a bad database migration on Friday evening; checkout was down 22 hours. Forensics found no attacker involvement. Claiming lost revenue.

why: Outage came from the insured's own bad deployment with no attacker, and the system-failure extension wasn't bought.

exclusions: Use of the yacht for charter, hire, or carrying passengers for payment

claim.description: Owner ran sunset cruises off Waikiki on weekends, advertised on social media at $95 a head. On a cruise with 8 paying guests the boat touched a coral head leaving the harbor.

why: Guests had paid per head for the cruise.

exclusions: Use for charter, hire or reward

claim.description: Weekend sail in the Solent with three friends. We always split the marina fees and diesel four ways. Hit a navigation buoy in poor visibility.

why: Friends splitting fuel and marina costs is not hire or reward.

exclusions: Any condition that results from lack of maintenance

claim.description: Rooftop unit 4 compressor failed on high head pressure.
claim.tech_report: Condenser coils fully matted with debris and cottonwood fluff; filters appear not to have been changed in years. Unit ran at excessive head pressure until failure. No maintenance contract in place.

why: Compressor failed from clogged coils and filters: lack of maintenance.

exclusions: Wear and tear, gradual deterioration, erosion, cavitation
Explosion of any boiler or pressure vessel

claim.description: The Francis turbine tripped on high vibration. On inspection a wooden log had passed the damaged trash rack after the spate and struck the runner, breaking one blade and damaging the guide vanes. Trash rack bar had been bent by a boulder in the same spate.
claim.engineer_report: Fresh impact damage on runner blade; fracture surface shows instantaneous overload, no fatigue beach marks. Runner otherwise in good condition, erosion within normal limits for age. Plant maintenance records complete; last overhaul within manufacturer interval.

why: Sudden impact by debris washed down in the spate; the engineer rules out wear, erosion and fatigue.

exclusions: Power surge damage to electronics unless caused by lightning

claim.description: Lightning struck the building during the afternoon storm. My TV, gaming PC and router were fried. Building manager confirmed the strike hit the rooftop.

why: Surge came from a lightning strike, the carve-out.

exclusions: Theft in or to a dwelling under construction, or of materials and supplies for use in the construction, until the dwelling is finished and occupied

claim.description: New build, closing was 2 weeks out, we hadn't moved in yet. Builder's super found the side door pried open and the new refrigerator, range, dishwasher and all the interior doors' hardware gone.

why: Theft from a new build before it was finished and occupied.

exclusions: Damage caused by trees being felled, lopped or pruned by you or someone acting on your behalf

claim.description: Our neighbour hired an arborist to take down a big gum on their side of the fence. The crew misjudged the drop and a large section landed on our back verandah roof. We had nothing to do with the job; the neighbour arranged and paid for it.

why: The tree was felled by the neighbour's contractor, not the insured or anyone acting for them.

claim.description: Neighbor kid on a bike rode into my parked car's door, big dent, scratched paint.

why: Parked car hit by a third party; none apply.

exclusions: Intentional damage caused by any insured (you or a resident relative)

claim.description: My ex-husband (divorced two years, lives in Henderson, not on my policy) keyed the car and slashed two tires in my apartment lot. I have a doorbell cam video and a protective order.

why: The ex-husband is neither the named insured nor a resident relative.

exclusions: Theft of the vehicle by any member of your household

claim.description: Our 19 year old daughter, who lives at home, took the truck without permission and sold it to a guy in Wichita for cash. We filed a police report against her.

why: Truck was taken by a daughter living in the household.

exclusions: Any condition, or clinical sign of a condition, that was noted by a vet or that you were aware of before the policy started

claim.diagnosis: Myxomatous mitral valve disease, stage B2
claim.vet_history: Previous practice, booster visit shortly before this policy began: 'Grade 1/6 left apical systolic murmur, soft, probably innocent, recheck next year.' Current: grade 4/6 murmur, echo shows mitral regurgitation and left atrial enlargement.

why: The murmur a vet noted before cover is a clinical sign of the same valve disease, even though it was called probably innocent.

claim.vet_history: Before cover: mild flea allergy dermatitis on the lower back, treated with flea control. Diabetes first diagnosed 18 months into the policy after increased thirst.

why: The only pre-cover issue was unrelated flea dermatitis.

exclusions: Cancellation due to voluntary resignation or termination for cause

claim.description: My company laid off 300 people including my whole department three weeks before our Hawaii trip. Letter attached says position eliminated, not performance-related. Can't afford to go now.

why: Involuntary layoff, not resignation or dismissal for cause.

claim.description: I was let go from my job before the trip and can't afford to travel.
claim.employer_letter: Employment terminated following an internal investigation that found repeated falsification of expense reports, in breach of company policy.

exclusions: Cancellation due to voluntary resignation or termination for cause

why: Employer letter shows dismissal for misconduct, even though the insured calls it being let go.

exclusions: Flight delay of less than 6 hours
Delay due to strikes announced before departure
Missed flight due to late arrival at airport
Delay of checked baggage under 12 hours

claim.description: Delhi to Dubai flight delayed 9 hours due to dense fog. Claiming meals and a transit hotel room.

why: Nine-hour weather delay; above the 6-hour threshold and not a strike.

exclusions: Settling, cracking, shrinkage, bulging or expansion of foundations, floors or walls, including frost heave

claim.description: After a cold winter with little snow cover, the warehouse slab at the unheated bay heaved and cracked in several places; racking now out of plumb.
claim.engineer: Frost penetration beneath slab; ice lensing lifted the floor.

why: Engineer puts the cracking down to frost heave.

exclusions: Damage by vehicles owned or operated by you or your employees

claim.description: Our delivery driver backed our own van into the shop front while loading, took out the plate glass window and door frame.

why: The insured's own van, driven by an employee, hit the shop.

exclusions: Infringement of patent, or misappropriation of trade secrets

claim.description: Suit filed by a patent holding company alleging our scheduling app infringes two US patents on calendar conflict resolution. Seeking defense costs.

why: It is a patent infringement suit.

exclusions: Infringement of patent, or misappropriation of trade secrets

claim.description: Photographer's attorney sent a demand alleging we used 14 of her photos on our website without a licence. Demanding $42,000.

why: A copyright claim over photos is not patent or trade secret.

policy.hurricane_plan: Haul out and store ashore on stands when a named storm warning is issued
exclusions: Loss from a named storm if the hurricane plan submitted with the application was not followed

claim.description: Owner was out of the country when the hurricane warning went up; boat stayed at the floating dock in Key Largo. Pilings broke and the boat was driven onto the seawall.

why: Boat stayed in the water, so the haul-out plan was not followed.

policy.hurricane_plan: Haul out at Oriental Marine and store on jack stands, strapped down
exclusions: Loss from a named storm if the hurricane plan was not followed

claim.description: Boat hauled at Oriental Marine two days before landfall and put on jack stands with tie-down straps per plan. Storm winds toppled the adjacent boat onto ours; hull holed.

why: Hurricane plan was followed.

exclusions: Flood, surface water, waves, tides, overflow of any body of water

claim.description: A 4-inch chilled water pipe split overnight in the mechanical room; room had about a foot of water by morning. Two pump motors and a control panel were submerged and shorted.

why: Water came from a burst pipe indoors, not flood or overflow of a body of water.

claim.description: Fell asleep with a candle burning on the nightstand; it caught the curtain. Bedroom contents burned before fire dept arrived.

why: Accidental candle fire; not intentional.

exclusions: Theft of property while the residence premises is rented or sublet to others, including short-term rentals

claim.description: I rented my apartment out on a home-sharing site for SXSW week while I stayed with my girlfriend. When I came back my record player, a Rolex and some vinyl were missing. Host platform opened a case against the guest.

why: Items were stolen while the apartment was sublet as a short-term rental.

exclusions: Theft from any part of the home that is lent, let or sublet, unless there is forcible entry

claim.description: We let our spare room to a lodger (student, pays monthly). After he moved out I noticed my laptop and my late mum's necklace were missing from our own bedroom, which he had no reason to be in. Police reference given; no forced entry to our room.

why: Items went from the owners' own bedroom, which was never let; only the let part of the home is excluded.

exclusions: Flood, surface water, waves, including tidal wave and storm surge, overflow of a body of water, whether or not driven by wind
Water below the surface of the ground
Mold unless resulting from a covered water loss and reported within 30 days

claim.description: Hurricane came ashore about 30 miles west. We sheltered in place; around 2 am the roof over the back half of the house went. Rain poured into the two back bedrooms and bathroom all night. Our street never flooded. Claiming roof, both bedrooms and the bathroom ceiling.
claim.adjuster_notes: Roof decking missing over rear third. Interior water damage limited to rooms under the opening, drip pattern from above. No water line on foundation or interior walls; nearest surge line 4 miles south. Early mold on bedroom drywall at inspection, reported with the claim.

why: Wind tore the roof off and rain came in from above; no surge, surface water or flood reached the house.

exclusions: Escape of water while unoccupied more than 30 days

claim.description: Radiator valve snapped when my son leaned on it, water sprayed across the lounge for 10 min before we found the stop tap. Laminate lifted.

why: Sudden break with the home occupied.

exclusions: Gradual damage, including damage by tree roots, rot, rust, or deterioration over time

claim.description: Toilets gurgling and slow for months. CCTV camera survey of the stormwater and sewer lines shows roots from the pōhutukawa have broken into the clay pipes at three joints, crushing a section.

why: Tree roots broke into the pipes over months: gradual root damage.

exclusions: Danos causados por alagamento ou enchente (cobertura não contratada)
Veículo conduzido por pessoa sem habilitação

claim.descricao: Segurada foi abordada por dois homens armados no semáforo da Av. Brasil e obrigada a sair do carro. Veículo levado, não recuperado. B.O. registrado na 21ª DP.

why: Armed robbery of the car; none apply.

policy.class_of_use: Social, domestic and pleasure only (no commuting, no business use)
exclusions: Any use not permitted by the class of use shown on the certificate

claim.description: I run a small parcel courier business and was halfway through my delivery round in Leeds when I went into the back of a bus at a stop. Car full of parcels at the time.

why: Mid-way through a paid courier round, with only social, domestic and pleasure use on the certificate.

claim.fnol_text: Rock kicked up on I-80 and left a small chip on the passenger side of the windshield, about the size of a dime. No cracks spreading. Just want it filled before it gets worse.
claim.notes: glass vendor preferred shop selected by insured

why: Single small glass chip with photos and a fixed repair price.

claim.fnol: Insured reports a leak through the ceiling of the upstairs bedroom after last week's storm. Water stain approx 1m x 1m, some drips into a bucket. Roofer has been out and found three lifted shingles and a cracked vent boot. Insured has already tarped. Estimate attached.

loss_items.desc: roof repair per Keller Roofing est.

why: Contained roof leak documented by photos and a contractor estimate; an adjuster can settle it from documents.

claim.notification: Pulled out of the Tesco car park on Brentwood Road and a van clipped my rear bumper. Honestly just a scrape and a cracked light. The other driver was fine, I was fine, we swapped details. I did get a bit of a stiff neck the next morning, probably whiplash but it's easing off. Just want the bumper sorted.

why: Policyholder reports whiplash, which is bodily injury despite the small property damage.

claim.fnol_text: My suitcase didn't arrive with me in Lisbon on flight TP1333. The airline delivered it 2 days later. I bought toiletries, underwear, a phone charger and 2 shirts in the meantime. Receipts attached. The airline's property irregularity report is attached too.

why: Small baggage-delay essentials claim with airline report and receipts.

claim.first_report: Employee was stacking pallets in freezer bay 3 and felt a pop in his lower back while lifting. Went to walk-in clinic same day, given muscle relaxants and 5 days off.

why: Workplace back injury is a bodily injury claim.

claim.fnol_text: hail storm yesterday in Amarillo. windshield is cracked all the way across and theres a big dent in the hood plus lots of little dings on roof. car still drives
claim.notes: insured asks if they can keep driving it

why: Widespread hail damage to glass, hood and roof needs an in-person inspection to scope.

claim.fnol: Biscuit had an ear infection, vet cleaned ears and gave drops. Invoice attached, paid in full.
claim.notes: policy in force 2 yrs, no pre-existing ear exclusions

why: Routine small vet invoice for a common illness.

claim.fnol_text: Large oak came down in the storm Tuesday night and landed on the back half of the house. It went through the roof over the family room. Now there's a crack running across the living room ceiling and the back door won't close right. We're staying at my sister's. Tree service removed the tree this morning.

why: Tree through the roof with signs of structural movement needs on-site inspection.

claim.fnol_text: Customer says she slipped on a wet floor near the restroom on 9/2. Staff helped her up; she said she was OK and left. Today we received a letter from her attorney saying she has a fractured wrist and demanding our insurance info.

why: Third-party bodily injury with an attorney involved.

claim.fnol_text: I rear-ended a Honda Civic at a red light in stop-and-go traffic. Low speed. Both cars drivable. Nobody hurt, we both said so to the officer. My front bumper is pushed in and her rear bumper is cracked.

loss_items.desc: insured vehicle front bumper, body shop est.

why: Two-vehicle property damage with photos and estimates; needs an adjuster to handle liability and the claimant, not an inspection.

claim.fnol_text: Fire started in the loading dock area overnight, fire department responded. Dock and about a third of the warehouse have smoke and water damage. Inventory of upholstery fabric affected. Building is closed until fire marshal clears it.

why: Warehouse fire with building and stock damage of unknown extent needs on-site inspection.

claim.fnol: We had to cancel our trip to Crete because my father was admitted to hospital in Krakow two days before departure. Hotel and flights were non-refundable. I attached the hospital discharge letter, booking confirmations and the airline's refusal of refund.

why: Trip cancellation needs review of medical reason and refund documents by an adjuster.

claim.fnol_text: Fahrzeug wurde heute Nacht aus der Tiefgarage in München-Bogenhausen gestohlen. Polizei informiert, Anzeige erstattet. Beide Schlüssel sind bei mir.

why: High-value total loss (theft of a very expensive vehicle) goes to a specialist unit.

claim.fnol_text: Someone took my mountain bike from the carport at home overnight. It was locked but they cut the cable. Reported to NSW Police, event number attached. Purchase receipt attached, bike was 18 months old.

why: Single stolen item with receipt and police report, small amount.

claim.fnol: Broken pipe under the pedicure station flooded the back room overnight. Plumber fixed it next morning. Laminate floor in back room lifted, bottom of two cabinets swollen. Closed for 1 day. Plumber invoice + photos + flooring quote attached.

why: Contained water loss with invoices and quotes; business income piece needs adjuster review, no inspection.

claim.fnol_text: Minor fender bender in the Kroger lot, other driver backed into my door. Door dented. Other driver's kid was in the back and started crying, mom said he bumped his head on the window but seemed fine. Didn't call police.
claim.injuries: unknown - child in other vehicle may have hit head

why: Possible head injury to a child passenger makes this a bodily injury claim despite the small dent.

claim.fnol_text: Dropped my phone on the pavement, screen is cracked but the phone still works. Model is a Nexa 14 Pro. Want to use the approved repair centre.

why: Routine phone screen repair with photo and IMEI.

claim.fnol_text: The basement flooded after the sump pump failed during the heavy rain. There's about 8 inches of standing water still, finished basement with carpet, a sectional couch, the furnace and water heater down there. We have a pump running now.

why: Finished basement with standing water and mechanicals affected; extent must be seen in person.

claim.fnol: Roof leak into the attic after the storm. Contractor came to tarp it and says two rafters look cracked and the ridge is sagging a bit, he doesn't want to quote until someone checks the framing. Photos of the attic attached.

why: Roof leak with a possible structural problem (cracked rafters, sagging ridge) needs an in-person inspection.

claim.fnol_text: My dog got out of the yard and bit the mail carrier on the leg. She went to urgent care and got stitches. Animal control came by and the dog is quarantined at home.
claim.injuries: yes - third party (mail carrier) bite with stitches

why: Dog bite to a third party is a bodily injury liability claim.

claim.fnol: Someone smashed the rear quarter window of my car in town and took a backpack (school books and a jacket). Just need the window fixed, not claiming the backpack.

why: Single small glass replacement after a break-in, photo and police reference provided.

claim.fnol_text: Our crew was painting an apartment exterior and overspray drifted onto 6 cars in the lot below. Building manager sent photos and a list of plates. Owners want them detailed. A detailer quoted per car.

why: Multi-claimant property damage liability documented by photos and a quote; needs an adjuster but not an inspection.

claim.fnol: t-boned at intersection by a pickup running the red. front passenger side crushed, airbags went off, car towed to Mike's Tow yard. me and my wife were checked by EMTs on scene and both refused transport, no injuries. police report # 24-11782
claim.loss_items: vehicle at tow yard, not estimated

why: Undrivable vehicle with heavy damage at a tow yard needs inspection; occupants explicitly uninjured and the car is not high value.

claim.fnol_text: We filed claim for the kitchen fire in June and you only paid for the cabinets next to the stove. The whole kitchen smelled of smoke and we had it professionally cleaned twice. Your adjuster said the smoke cleaning isn't covered. We disagree and are invoking the appraisal clause per the policy. Letter from our public adjuster attached.

why: Formal coverage dispute with appraisal invoked and a public adjuster involved.

claim.fnol: Luna (7yo) needed surgery to remove a bladder stone. Vet notes attached. Also, when we signed up last year the vet had noted 'urinary issues' in her history but that was a one-time UTI 3 years ago.

why: Large pet surgery with a possible pre-existing condition needs an adjuster's review of the records.

claim.fnol_text: Backed into a parked Subaru at the gym. Tiny scuff on their bumper, maybe $400. I left a note, the owner called me. Then last week I got a letter from a law firm representing her saying she wants compensation. No one was in the car.

why: An attorney representation letter means litigation risk, even though the damage is tiny.

claim.fnol: Flight SQ-type service from Singapore to Osaka delayed 7 hours due to technical issue. Airline letter confirming delay attached. Claiming fixed delay benefit.

why: Fixed flight-delay benefit with airline confirmation.

claim.fnol_text: Kitchen fire, grease pan on the stove. Put out with extinguisher before FD arrived. Cabinets above stove charred, microwave melted, smoke through the downstairs. Upstairs smells too.

why: Fire and smoke spread through the home needs an on-site scope.

claim.fnol: Tech cut his palm on sheet metal edge at a job site. Went to urgent care, 4 stitches, returned to work next day, no lost time.

why: Even a medical-only workplace laceration is a bodily injury claim.

claim.fnol_text: Knocked a glass of red wine over the laptop while working at home. Won't turn on. Repair shop says liquid damage to the logic board, cheaper to replace. Their report attached.

why: Single accidental-damage item with repair report and receipt.

claim.fnol: Container of ceramic tiles arrived Lagos with 38 of 400 cartons broken. Surveyor attended at the port and issued report. Commercial invoice and packing list attached.

why: Inspection already done by a surveyor; remaining work is document review and recovery.

claim.fnol_text: car was parked on street overnight, woke up to find someone sideswiped it. drivers side mirror hanging off and scrapes along the front door. no note left. photos attached. dealership quoted mirror + door refinish

why: Moderate hit-and-run damage with photos and a quote; adjuster reviews documents, no inspection needed.

claim.fnol_text: Customer emailed that one of our 3-wick candles cracked the glass jar while burning and hot wax burned her hand. She sent a photo of a blister and says she saw a doctor. Asking for refund and medical costs.

why: Product-caused burn injury is a bodily injury liability claim.

claim.fnol: Straight-line winds took part of the roof off the machine shed and knocked the grain bin off its foundation. Bin is leaning. Combine inside the shed may have been hit by debris, haven't gotten in to look.

why: Multiple farm structures and equipment with unknown damage require on-site inspection.

claim.fnol_text: Pepper ate a sock, vet induced vomiting and it came up. Home same day.

why: Small routine accident vet bill with invoice and notes.

claim.fnol_text: Our driver was making a delivery on Elm St and a cyclist ran into the open van door. Cyclist was taken by ambulance with a possible broken collarbone. Police attended.

why: Third-party cyclist injured and hospitalised.

claim.fnol: House break-in while on vacation. Back door forced. Taken: two laptops, my wife's jewelry box (rings, a gold chain, grandmother's brooch), a gaming console, and cash. Police report attached. I have receipts for the laptops and console but not most of the jewelry; some photos of her wearing it.

why: Theft with undocumented jewelry values needs adjuster valuation by documents and interview.

claim.fnol_text: Noticed cracks in the brick on the north side of the house, zig-zag pattern, and two interior doors now stick. Neighbor says there was a water main break on the street last month. Could it be settling?

why: Possible foundation movement needs someone to inspect the structure.

claim.fnol_text: Insured fell while hiking in Patagonia, suspected hip fracture. Admitted to hospital in El Calafate. Family requesting evacuation to Buenos Aires or repatriation to Netherlands.

why: Serious bodily injury abroad with possible medical evacuation.

claim.notification: Stone chip in windscreen has now spread into a crack across the driver's line of sight so it has to be replaced not repaired. Car has the lane-assist camera behind the mirror so needs recalibration.

why: Windscreen replacement plus calibration is still a routine glass claim with photo and fixed price.

claim.fnol: Walk-in cooler compressor died over the long weekend. Dairy, meat and produce spoiled. Refrigeration company invoice says compressor failure. Spoiled stock list from our POS attached.

why: Spoilage and equipment breakdown need adjuster review of invoices and stock records; nothing left to inspect.

claim.fnol_text: Car was stolen from outside our apartment Friday. Police found it Sunday in a field, burned out. It's a 2011 Nissan Altima, 180k miles.

why: Recovered burnt vehicle needs inspection to confirm total loss; low value so not a specialist total loss.

claim.fnol_text: Received a summons today. Former client alleges we missed the extension deadline on their 2022 return, causing penalties and interest of about $38k. Complaint attached.

why: Active lawsuit against the insured.

claim.fnol_text: My son threw a toy and cracked our TV screen. It's a 55 inch, bought 2 years ago. Photo and the original receipt attached.

why: Single low-value accidental damage item with photo and receipt.

claim.fnol: Hit a kangaroo on the Warrego Hwy at dusk. Front end smashed in, radiator leaking, bonnet won't close. Towed to Dalby. Nobody hurt.

why: Undrivable vehicle with heavy front-end damage needs an assessor to inspect it.

claim.fnol_text: Resident's guest tripped on raised sidewalk slab near the pool and says she twisted her ankle. No ER visit reported. Guest is asking HOA to pay for a physio visit.

why: Small amount, but it is a third-party bodily injury claim.

claim.fnol_text: Power surge from lightning strike nearby. Fried the TV, the router, garage door opener and the HVAC control board. HVAC tech replaced the board and wrote on the invoice 'lightning/surge damage'. Receipts for the rest.

why: Several items with a cause-of-loss question; an adjuster can verify by documents.

claim.fnol: Rental company in Malaga charged my card EUR 300 for a small scratch on the rear bumper found at return. Damage report, their invoice and the card statement are attached. I have excess reimbursement cover.

why: Small excess reimbursement backed by the rental company's documents.

claim.fnol_text: Deer ran out on Route 9. Hit it with the front right. Headlight broken, bumper cover cracked, fender pushed in a little. Still drivable, just one headlight. Took photos. Body shop wrote an estimate.

loss_items.desc: headlamp, bumper cover, RF fender (shop est.)

why: Drivable car with photographed moderate damage and a shop estimate can be reviewed at the desk.

claim.fnol_text: Hurricane surge flooded the dry-stack building to about 4 feet. Forklifts were under water, the office and electrical panels too. Customer boats on the lower racks may be damaged. Access road just reopened.

why: Large flood loss to building and equipment of unknown extent needs on-site inspection.

claim.fnol: CHIP IN WINDSHIELD LOWER LEFT. NO CRACK. INSD WANTS MOBILE REPAIR AT WORK.

why: Windshield chip repair, fixed price, photo.

claim.aviso: Colisão traseira no semáforo da Av. Paulista. O outro motorista bateu atrás de mim. Para-choque traseiro amassado. Ninguém ferido. Boletim de ocorrência e fotos anexados. Orçamento da oficina credenciada também.

why: Two-party rear-end with photos, police record and estimate; adjuster handles liability and recovery by documents.

claim.fnol: CNA was helping transfer a resident from bed to wheelchair and resident grabbed her arm and twisted. Shoulder pain, sent to occupational health. Off work pending MRI.

why: Workplace shoulder injury with lost time.

claim.fnol_text: Wind blew down about 30 feet of our wood privacy fence. Posts snapped at the base. Fence company quote and photos attached. Nothing else damaged.

why: Wind fence loss with photos and quote; above routine auto-pay but no inspection needed.

claim.fnol_text: Minor accident. I was waiting to turn left and a car tapped my rear. Very slow. No visible damage on either car really, maybe a scratch. My passenger (my mother, 78) says her back hurts since, she's going to see her doctor Monday.

why: Passenger reports back pain, so it is a bodily injury claim despite no damage.

claim.fnol: annual claim for our cat Mochi's allergy meds, apoquel-type tablets, 3 months supply. vet prescription & pharmacy receipt attached

why: Small prescription reimbursement with prescription and receipt.

claim.fnol_text: 台風10号で瓦が数枚飛び、雨漏りで2階の天井にシミ。瓦屋さんの見積書と写真あり。
claim.fnol_text_en: Typhoon No.10 blew off several roof tiles; rain leak left a stain on 2nd floor ceiling. Tile contractor estimate and photos available.

why: Contained roof leak with contractor estimate and photos; settleable from documents.

claim.fnol_text: Found black mold growing behind the washing machine and up the laundry room wall. There's a slow leak from the supply hose, not sure for how long. The drywall is soft. Smell is strong in the hallway too.

why: Hidden long-term water and mold spread needs in-person inspection to scope and determine cause.

claim.fnol_text: Garage fire at a restoration shop. My car was inside and is burned to the frame. Shop owner's insurer has been notified too.

why: High-value total loss with a third party involved goes to a specialist.

claim.fnol_text: Checked bag lost by airline on Mumbai-Frankfurt-Toronto. After 21 days airline declared it permanently lost and paid USD 400. Bag contained clothes, a DSLR camera with 2 lenses, wedding gifts (silver items). Some bills available, some not.

why: High-value lost baggage with partial proof and an airline payment to offset; needs adjuster review.

claim.fnol_text: my car got flooded in the parking garage during the storm, water came up to the dashboard. won't start. its a 2021 Kia Sorento. its still sitting there, garage says we have 3 days to move it.

why: Flooded vehicle must be inspected to decide repair or total loss.

claim.fnol: Kid from next door was on our trampoline, fell off and broke his arm. His parents have been nice about it but asked if our insurance covers the ER bill.

why: Third-party child with a fracture is a bodily injury claim.

claim.fnol_text: Zero-turn mower stolen off the trailer at a job site in daylight. Police report filed. Serial number and purchase invoice attached.

why: Theft of a scheduled item above routine thresholds; document review and valuation, nothing to inspect.

claim.fnol_text: Food in our fridge and chest freezer spoiled after a 3-day power outage from the ice storm. Utility outage notice attached. Claiming the fixed food spoilage benefit.

why: Fixed food-spoilage benefit after a documented outage.

claim.fnol_text: I got a ticket for hitting a parked car, but I didn't hit it. The car's owner told police he saw a car like mine. Your office already told me you're paying his claim and my rates will go up. I want this reviewed, I'm filing a complaint with the state insurance department.

why: Formal regulatory complaint disputing the claim decision needs a specialist unit rather than routine handling.

claim.fnol: Hail damage on the Golf, dents on roof and bonnet, all over. Windows fine. Parked outside at work in Centurion.

why: Widespread hail denting with no photos needs an assessor to inspect and count damage.

claim.fnol_text: Left my prescription sunglasses in a taxi in Rome. Taxi company couldn't find them. Receipt from optician attached.

why: Single small personal item with receipt.

claim.fnol_text: Roof HVAC unit condensate line clogged and dripped through one ceiling tile over the reception desk. Replaced 3 tiles, dried out. Maintenance invoice + photos attached.

why: Commercial policy but a tiny, already repaired, fully documented water drip.

claim.fnol_text: Shareholder derivative demand letter received alleging board failed to disclose trial delays. Notice of circumstances.

why: D&O litigation demand.

claim.fnol_text: Hit a pothole and blew out front tire and bent the rim. Tire shop replaced both. Receipt attached.

why: Small single-event repair already done, receipt and photo.

claim.declaration: Dégât des eaux venant de l'appartement du dessus (fuite de la machine à laver du voisin). Plafond de la salle de bain taché et peinture qui cloque. Constat amiable dégât des eaux signé avec le voisin. Devis du peintre joint.

why: Water damage from a neighbor with a signed report and quote; adjuster handles recovery by documents.

claim.fnol_text: Homeowner says our crew's ladder scraped her car in the driveway while we were loading up. Small scratch on the door. She sent a photo and a body shop quote.

why: Third-party liability property damage needs adjuster to confirm liability, by documents.

claim.fnol_text: Rolled the car on an icy curve on Hwy 2. Car is on its roof in the ditch, being towed. I walked away with a few scratches from glass, got checked at the ER and released with a couple of steri-strips.

why: The driver was treated at the ER for injuries, so it is a bodily injury claim despite being single-vehicle.

claim.fnol_text: Hurricane. Water came into the whole first floor, about 2 feet. Drywall, floors, kitchen cabinets, furniture. Also part of the roof on the back porch is gone. We evacuated and just got back.

why: Major hurricane damage throughout the home needs on-site inspection.

claim.fnol_text: Front plate glass window of the shop was smashed overnight, nothing taken as far as we can tell. Glazier boarded it and replaced it the next day. Invoice + police ref attached.

why: Single glass loss already repaired with invoice and police reference; routine despite the commercial line.
