claim.fnol_text: Heavy snow load, part of the roof over bay 2 collapsed around 4am. No one in the building. CNC machines under that section, we don't know the condition. City building inspector red-tagged bay 2.

why: Roof collapse over machinery with unknown damage must be inspected on site.

claim.fnol: Other car ran a stop sign and hit my front left corner. Wheel is bent sideways, car won't steer, towed to Brennan's Collision. Other driver cited. No injuries, I'm fine and so was she.

why: Undrivable car with suspension damage needing teardown requires an in-person appraisal.

claim.fnol_text: Water heater burst in the garage. Garage floor was wet, we shop-vac'd it. Plumber replaced the heater and said the old one just failed from age. Nothing else damaged except a cardboard box of old magazines.

why: Small amount, but a worn-out appliance raises a coverage question an adjuster must decide; no inspection needed.

claim.fnol_text: Rufus got into a fight with another dog at the park. He has a torn ear, stitched by vet. The other owner got bitten on the hand trying to separate them and is asking me to pay her doctor bill.

why: A person was bitten and is claiming medical costs, which makes it a bodily injury claim.

claim.notification: Large crack has opened up in the rear extension wall, running diagonally from the window corner. Getting wider over the summer. There are two big willow trees near the boundary. Worried it's subsidence.

why: Suspected subsidence requires a structural site visit.

claim.fnol_text: Had to cut my holiday short and fly home from Cancun because my house was broken into. Attaching new flight receipt and police report from home.

why: Trip interruption needs adjuster review of reason and unused costs.

claim.fnol_text: Windshield has a big crack across the whole thing from a rock AND the rock put a dent in the hood too. Photos attached.

why: Windshield plus an unquoted hood dent is no longer a glass-only claim; the body damage needs an appraiser to see it.

claim.fnol_text: Tenant in unit 3 says the stair railing gave way and she fell down four steps. Taken to hospital by her daughter, has a sprained knee and bruises. Handyman repaired railing next day.

why: Tenant injured in a fall on the insured's property.

claim.fnol_text: Parked car in the lot at work, came back to a dented rear door. Security cameras show a car backing into it. Photos + body shop estimate.

why: Small paintless dent repair with photo and estimate; recovery is optional and the payment is routine.

claim.fnol_text: Chimney fire. Fire department came, said it was contained to the flue, but there's smoke smell in the living room and some black streaks on the ceiling around the fireplace. The chimney sweep says the liner is cracked and the masonry above the roofline is loose.

why: Fire with possible masonry damage and smoke needs an in-person inspection.

claim.fnol_text: Employee reports carpal tunnel type pain in right wrist from years of repetitive work at the snack counter. Saw her own doctor.

why: Workplace cumulative injury claim.

claim.fnol_text: Wedding ring slipped off in the sea on holiday in Cornwall. Specified item on my policy. Valuation certificate attached.

why: A specified item lost with a valuation certificate; loss is simple and value is pre-agreed.

claim.fnol_text: Our refuse truck caught fire on the route, driver got out safely. Truck is burnt from the cab back to the hopper. Towed to our yard. Truck value approx $310k.

why: Probable total loss of a high-value vehicle (~$310k) goes to the major loss unit even though no one was hurt.

claim.fnol: Bushfire came through the back of the property. Shed and back fence burnt, house scorched along the rear wall, some windows cracked from heat. Can't get in yet, area still closed by RFS.

why: Bushfire damage of unknown extent needs an on-site assessment.

claim.fnol_text: Battery died at the grocery store, had it towed to the shop 3 miles away. Receipt attached.

why: Towing reimbursement with a receipt.

claim.fnol_text: We delivered a bounce house to a birthday party. Wind gust lifted one corner while kids were inside. Parent says two kids were thrown and one has a concussion. We haven't heard from anyone else.

why: Child injuries with potential liability.

claim.fnol_text: Upstairs toilet supply line burst while we were out. Water ran for maybe 5 hours, came through the kitchen ceiling below, and the hardwood in the hall is cupping. Restoration company has fans and dehumidifiers running.

why: Multi-floor water loss still drying, with ceiling and hardwood affected; needs someone on site despite the photos.

claim.fnol_text: Our dog Hazel had cruciate ligament surgery (TPLO). Total $6,450. Vet notes and invoice attached. She had a limp on the other leg last year too.

why: Large surgery with bilateral-condition history needs an adjuster's review of records.

claim.aviso: Sismo de magnitud 6.8. En la nave industrial se ven grietas en muros de carga y se desprendió parte del plafón. Protección Civil pidió desalojar hasta revisión estructural.

why: Earthquake structural damage to an industrial building needs on-site inspection.

claim.fnol_text: Lost one of my two car keys (smart key). Dealer programmed a replacement. Invoice attached.

why: Key replacement cover, single small invoice.

claim.fnol_text: Homeowner says our electrician's work caused a fire in their attic 2 weeks after we rewired it. Their homeowner insurer has paid them and sent us a subrogation demand for $86,000 with an expert report.

why: Large third-party subrogation demand with expert causation dispute is litigation-grade.

claim.fnol_text: Burglary. They took a TV, an iPad-type tablet and a watch. Front door lock broken. Police report attached, receipts for TV and tablet. The watch was a Rolex-style from my dad, no receipt.

why: Burglary with an undocumented high-value watch needs adjuster valuation.

claim.fnol_text: Rear-ended on I-35 in stop and go. They hit hard. Trunk crumpled, bumper on ground, rear window cracked. Car was drivable enough to get home but the trunk won't close.

why: Significant rear structural damage without photos or estimate requires an in-person appraisal.

claim.fnol_text: Cancelled my ski trip because I tore my ACL playing football two weeks before. Orthopedic surgeon's note, MRI report, and the chalet's no-refund letter are attached.
claim.injuries: yes - insured's own knee injury (reason for cancellation)

why: The injury is only the reason for cancelling; no one claims for it, so this is document review of a cancellation.

claim.fnol_text: Last month you denied my claim for the hail damage to my roof saying it was old wear. I had two roofers look and both say it's hail. I've hired an attorney and he's sending a letter.

why: Coverage dispute with an attorney retained.

claim.fnol_text: Train from Oslo to the airport was cancelled so I missed my flight to Tromsø. Had to buy a new ticket for the later flight. Vy cancellation notice and the new ticket receipt attached.

why: Small missed-connection claim with carrier notice and receipt.

claim.fnol_text: Annual vaccinations and a checkup for both cats. We have the wellness add-on. Invoice attached.

why: Routine wellness claim with invoice.

claim.fnol: scraped the side of my car on a concrete pillar in the parking garage. long scratch down both doors on passenger side, no dents. photos + quote from the body shop.

why: Single-vehicle cosmetic scrape, photos and quote, no third party; routine enough to pay without an adjuster.

claim.fnol_text: Ice dam on the north side, water came in around the bedroom window. Wall drywall stained under the window and the carpet corner is damp. Contractor estimate attached along with photos. We've had the gutters cleared.

why: Contained ice dam leak with estimate and photos.

claim.fnol_text: Customer found a piece of hard plastic in her pizza and says she chipped a tooth. She's going to the dentist and wants us to pay.

why: A chipped tooth is a bodily injury claim, however small.

claim.fnol_text: Break-in overnight. Thieves took two milling machines and a laptop. Door frame damaged. Police report attached, asset register with serial numbers attached.

why: Large theft but fully documented; valuation and document review, nothing needs inspecting beyond a door frame.

claim.fnol_text: I was hit by an uninsured driver who fled. I'm OK but my back has been killing me since, I'm seeing a chiropractor 3x a week. Car has a crushed rear quarter.

why: Uninsured motorist bodily injury claim with ongoing treatment.

claim.schadenmeldung: Fahrrad vor dem Bahnhof Köln-Ehrenfeld gestohlen, war mit Bügelschloss angeschlossen. Anzeige bei der Polizei gemacht. Kaufbeleg anbei.

why: Single stolen bike with receipt and police report.

claim.fnol_text: A car lost control and drove into the front of our house last night. It went through the porch and into the front wall of the living room. Driver was arrested for DUI. Nobody inside was hurt, driver was taken to hospital as a precaution. Front wall is bowed.

why: Our claim is the structural damage to the house, which needs inspection; the driver is not our claimant.

claim.fnol_text: Car stolen from my driveway overnight, not recovered yet. 2022 Hyundai Elantra. Police report filed. I have both keys.

why: Unrecovered theft of an ordinary car is handled by document review and valuation.

claim.fnol_text: Operative fell approx 3m from a scaffold lift on site in Gateshead. Airlifted to RVI. HSE notified under RIDDOR.

why: Serious workplace injury with regulator involvement.

claim.fnol_text: Sunroof glass shattered while driving on the highway, no idea why. Dealer replaced it. Invoice and photo attached.

why: Single glass replacement already done, invoice provided.

claim.fnol_text: Lightning hit our house. Fire department came because there was a burning smell, they found scorch marks in the attic and cut into a wall to check. No active fire. Several outlets dead, electrician coming tomorrow.

why: Lightning strike with attic scorching and electrical damage of unknown extent needs inspection.

claim.fnol_text: Our main oven's control board failed and the bakery couldn't produce for 4 days. Repair invoice attached, plus our sales for the same week last year and the last 4 weeks.

why: Business income calculation needs adjuster review of financials.

claim.fnol_text: We got served. A member who fell bouldering last year (we had a waiver) has filed suit for a torn ACL.

why: Bodily injury lawsuit.

claim.fnol_text: Airline broke the wheel off my suitcase. Airline gave me a damage report but said they don't cover wheels. Photo and suitcase receipt attached.

why: Small baggage damage with report, photo and receipt.

claim.fnol_text: The dishwasher leaked under the kitchen floor. Didn't notice until the tiles started lifting. Now the plumber says the subfloor is soft and there's water in the crawlspace. He can't say how far it goes.

why: Hidden water under floors and in the crawlspace of unknown extent needs inspection.

claim.fnol_text: Side-swiped merging on the parkway. Other driver says I merged into her; I say she was in my blind spot drifting. No injuries. Both cars drivable. Scratches and a dented fender on mine, her mirror is broken. Dashcam footage attached.

why: Disputed liability on a minor collision; adjuster reviews footage and statements.

claim.fnol_text: Wildfire destroyed the main house and guest house. Total loss. Coverage A limit $4.2M, fine art and wine collections scheduled separately.

why: High-value total loss goes to a major loss specialist.

claim.fnol_text: A neighbor's tree branch fell in the storm and crushed part of our back fence and a garden shed. Shed was just a plastic one. Photos and a quote from the fence guy attached.

why: Two small items with photos and quote but a neighbor's tree raises recovery questions; document review.

claim.fnol_text: backing out of my driveway I clipped my own mailbox. small dent in the bumper. not claiming the mailbox, just the bumper. photo + estimate

why: Small single-vehicle damage with photo and estimate.

claim.fnol_text: Tornado touched down near the facility. Roofs on buildings C and D peeled back, rain got into about 40 units. Tenants are calling us. Gate is working.

why: Tornado roof damage to multiple buildings needs on-site inspection.

claim.fnol_text: You denied the claim for Oscar's hip dysplasia saying it's pre-existing. The vet's records show nothing about hips before we took out the policy. I've asked for an internal review and will go to the Financial Ombudsman if needed.

why: Formal challenge of a coverage denial with ombudsman escalation is a coverage dispute despite the modest amount.

claim.fnol_text: Raccoons got into the attic and tore up the insulation and chewed some wires. Wildlife removal company got them out. They wrote an estimate to replace insulation. Photos attached.

why: Animal damage with coverage limits and estimates to review; photos suffice, the wiring piece can be handled with an electrician's report.

claim.fnol_text: My wife was driving and slid into a light pole on ice. Front end damage, airbags deployed, car towed. She has a burn on her wrist from the airbag and a bruised chest, saw her doctor.

why: Driver was injured and treated.

claim.fnol_text: Hail storm. Roofer came out and says the whole roof has hail bruising and needs replacing, and the gutters and the siding on the west side are dented. He gave me an estimate. I took photos from the ground.

why: Full roof replacement based on a roofer's claim of hail bruising needs an adjuster on the roof to verify; ground photos can't show it.

claim.fnol_text: Got food poisoning in Bangkok, went to a clinic, got IV fluids and was sent back to the hotel the same day. Receipt and doctor's note attached.

why: A one-off outpatient illness bill on travel medical is routine reimbursement, not an injury claim against anyone.

claim.fnol_text: Someone keyed my car along the driver side and the hood. Scratched through to the primer. Photos + shop estimate. Police report attached.

why: Vandalism with photos and a mid-size estimate; adjuster reviews documents.

claim.fnol_text: Lost a diamond stud earring, one of a scheduled pair. The pair is scheduled at $3,200.

why: Loss of one of a pair needs an adjuster's judgment on pair-and-set valuation, though the item is scheduled.

claim.fnol_text: A fermentation tank support leg buckled and the tank tipped over into the next one. Two tanks down, 60 barrels of beer lost, floor drain overwhelmed. Structural engineer hasn't seen it yet.

why: Equipment collapse with possible structural and product damage needs on-site inspection.

claim.fnol_text: small chip on windshield, glass company came and fixed it already, here's the invoice

why: Completed chip repair, tiny invoice.

claim.fnol: Other car rear-ended me at a roundabout in Galway, pushed me into the car in front. Three cars involved. My car front and back damaged, drivable but the bonnet is bent. Nobody injured but the guy in front says his car is a write-off.

why: Front and rear damage from a chain collision, bent bonnet and no estimate: the vehicle needs an assessor; no injuries reported.

claim.fnol_text: Clothes dryer caught fire in the laundry room. We put it out. The dryer is ruined and the laundry room wall behind it is black. Smoke smell mostly in the laundry room.

why: Any interior fire needs inspection to check wall cavity and smoke spread, even when it looks contained.

claim.fnol_text: Worker got a chlorine splash in his eye while mixing chemicals. Flushed on site, went to urgent care. Eye irritation, given drops, back tomorrow.

why: Workplace eye injury.

claim.fnol_text: My tour operator went bankrupt 3 weeks before our trip. Card company refused chargeback. Receipts and the operator's insolvency notice attached.

why: Supplier-failure cancellation needs coverage and document review.

claim.fnol_text: Tree fell on my parked car during the storm. Roof caved in, windshield broken, back window broken. Tree is still on it.

why: Crushed vehicle needs inspection for repair vs total loss.

claim.fnol_text: Coco cut her paw on glass at the beach. 3 stitches. Invoice attached.

why: Small pet accident invoice.

claim.fnol_text: Customer says our movers dropped her antique armoire on the stairs and it's split along the side. She got an appraisal of the armoire from an antiques dealer ($6,000) and a restoration quote ($1,800).

why: Third-party property damage with documents; adjuster decides value and repair.

claim.fnol_text: Windstorm took off a section of vinyl siding on the back of the house, about 3 panels. Photos attached. Handyman said he can put new ones up for $260.

why: Small wind siding repair with photo and quote.

claim.fnol_text: Fire in unit 12 spread to units 11 and 14 and the attic. Tenants displaced. Fire marshal investigating cause. One tenant treated for smoke inhalation.

why: Large multi-unit fire with a tenant injury.

claim.fnol_text: i was in a car accident today on Main st. the other driver hit me when i was turning. my car is smashed on the side. im ok. the airbag deployed. the car is at my house its still drivable kind of, the door wont open

why: Side impact with airbag deployment and no photos needs an in-person damage appraisal.

claim.fnol_text: Our garbage disposal leaked into the cabinet under the sink. Cabinet floor warped. Plumber fixed the disposal. Cabinet guy says he can replace the base. Photos and quotes attached.

why: Small, contained leak already fixed with photos and quotes; routine enough to pay without an adjuster.

claim.fnol_text: Our box truck driver rear-ended a sedan at a light. Sedan driver said she was fine at the scene. Photos of both vehicles taken by our driver. Now her insurer says she's claiming a neck injury.

why: A later neck injury claim turns it into bodily injury despite 'fine at the scene'.

claim.fnol_text: Burst pipe in the crawlspace during the freeze, flooded the crawlspace. Plumber fixed the pipe. The HVAC ducts down there are wet, some insulation fell down. We haven't been under there, just the plumber.

why: Unseen crawlspace water damage to ducts and insulation needs inspection.

claim.fnol_text: My phone was pickpocketed on the metro in Barcelona. Police report (denuncia) attached, and proof of purchase.

why: Single stolen item with police report and receipt.

claim.fnol_text: Other car backed into mine in a parking lot. The other driver admitted fault in a text. Both cars drivable. Photos and body shop estimate attached. No one hurt.

why: Third-party collision with documents; adjuster handles subrogation, no inspection.

claim.fnol: Heavy rain caused a landslip at the back of the section. The retaining wall has partly collapsed and the ground is within about 2m of the house. Council inspector has been out and placed a yellow sticker.

why: Landslip threatening the house needs on-site geotechnical/field inspection.

claim.fnol_text: My car's been at the shop for the covered collision claim (claim AU-24-4488201). I rented a car for 6 days. Receipt attached.

why: Rental reimbursement tied to an open claim, with receipt.

claim.fnol_text: Roof leak during storm. Water stains in two bedrooms and the hallway ceiling. Roofer found damaged flashing around the chimney. He also said the decking under there is rotted through and he could see daylight, which he thinks has been going on for a while.

why: Rotted decking suggests long-term deterioration; someone needs to inspect to separate storm damage from wear.

claim.fnol_text: My roommate's space heater tipped over and burned a hole in my rug and scorched my desk chair. Photos and receipts attached. Landlord says the room is fine.

why: Two small contents items with photos and receipts.

claim.fnol_text: Insured's teen son was driving, rear-ended a car at low speed. Other car had 3 occupants, all said they were fine. Agent note: 2 days later one passenger went to ER complaining of headaches.

why: A passenger went to the ER afterwards: bodily injury despite the low-speed impact.

claim.fnol_text: Our upstairs AC unit's drain pan overflowed and water came through the ceiling in the dining room. Small stain, about 2 feet across. AC tech cleared the drain. Drywall guy quote + photos attached.

why: Small, already resolved ceiling stain with photos and a low quote; routine.

claim.fnol_text: My car was vandalized. All 4 tires slashed. Tire shop replaced them. Police report and receipt attached.

why: Simple vandalism repair already done, receipt and report.

claim.fnol_text: While we were removing a tree, a large limb fell the wrong way onto the neighbor's garage. Garage roof caved in partially. The neighbor's car was inside.

why: Third-party structural and vehicle damage of unknown extent needs inspection.

claim.fnol_text: Forklift operator's foot run over by a pallet jack. X-ray shows two broken toes. Off work 2 weeks.

why: Workplace fracture with lost time.

claim.fnol_text: Suitcase lost on the way back from Tenerife. Airline has not found it after 5 weeks and declared it lost. Airline paid EUR 1,300 per Montreal Convention. Contents list attached, receipts for about half of it.

why: Lost baggage with partial receipts and an airline offset; adjuster calculation needed.

claim.fnol_text: Car was hit while parked in front of my house. The driver hit it hard enough to push it onto the curb. Rear wheel is tilted, rear bumper and quarter panel crushed. The other driver stopped, has insurance.

why: Suspension and structural damage of unknown extent needs an in-person appraisal.

claim.fnol_text: Milo swallowed a corn cob, needed surgery to remove it from his intestine. 3 nights in hospital. Invoice $5,200.

why: Clearly covered accident but a large bill needing adjuster sign-off on the itemized charges.

claim.fnol_text: Neighbor's kid threw a baseball through our living room window. The parents offered to pay but we'd rather go through insurance. Glazier quote attached.

why: Single small window replacement with photo and quote.

claim.fnol_text: A contractor I hired to clean gutters fell off his ladder at my house. He says he broke his wrist. He doesn't have his own insurance and his wife called asking for my insurance.

why: Third-party injury on the insured's premises.

claim.fnol_text: Sewer backup through floor drains in the kennel area and two exam rooms. Water was about an inch deep. Clinic closed today. Restoration crew is extracting.

why: Category 3 sewage water in several rooms needs an on-site scope.

claim.fnol_text: We had a claim for the fire in April, the house was rebuilt, but you're refusing to pay the extra for code upgrades the city required. Our policy has ordinance or law coverage. We've sent three emails with no response. I've contacted a lawyer.

why: Coverage dispute with a lawyer involved.

claim.fnol_text: Hit a curb in the snow, front passenger wheel is bent and the car pulls to the right now. Photos attached. Shop says wheel, tie rod and alignment.

why: Suspension parts claimed from a curb strike need an adjuster to check the estimate, but photos and the shop estimate suffice.

claim.fnol_text: bag delayed 1 day in Dubai, bought a shirt and toiletries. receipts attached. airline PIR attached.

why: Small baggage delay purchases with PIR and receipts.

claim.fnol_text: My car was hit in a multi-car pileup on the interstate in fog. I don't know how many cars. My car was hit front and back. I was taken to the hospital for a check and released. The car was towed, not sure where.

why: Multi-vehicle pileup with hospital visit.

claim.fnol: Tenant in our rental basement suite reports water coming through the foundation wall during spring melt. Carpet soaked along one wall. Tenant sent photos. We live out of province.

why: Foundation seepage with unknown extent and cause; needs an inspection on site.

claim.fnol_text: My apartment was broken into. They took my laptop, my PlayStation, headphones and about 15 games. Police report and receipts for the laptop and PS5, bank statement shows headphones purchase.

why: Multi-item theft with some items lacking proof; adjuster reviews documents.

claim.fnol_text: Charter bus slid off the road in freezing rain and tipped on its side. 31 passengers, several injured, 6 taken to hospital.

why: Mass casualty bodily injury loss.

claim.fnol_text: A small grease fire on our outdoor grill scorched the vinyl siding next to it. About a 3x3 area of siding melted. Photo + siding quote.

why: Although it is a fire, it was outdoors and limited to a small, photographed siding patch with a quote.

claim.fnol_text: Guest left the bathtub running in room 304. Water leaked into 204 and 104 below. Ceilings in 204 and 104 stained, carpets wet. 3 rooms out of service. Restoration company invoice and photos attached, drying complete.

why: Multi-room water loss, but drying is done and it is fully documented; desk review of invoices and income.

claim.fnol_text: Was hit by a delivery van while stopped. My rear hatch is caved in and won't close. The van driver's company is disputing, says I reversed into them. I have a dashcam but it wasn't recording.

why: Unestimated rear structural damage needs appraisal; the liability dispute is ordinary, not litigation.

claim.fnol_text: Bella (rabbit) had dental overgrowth trimmed under sedation. Invoice attached.

why: Routine small exotic pet dental invoice.

claim.fnol_text: Our deck collapsed during a party. Nobody hurt thank god, everyone was off it for the cake. Ledger board pulled away from the house.

why: Structural collapse attached to the house needs someone to inspect the cause and damage.

claim.fnol_text: Underlying auto carrier notifies us that a suit arising from our insured's crash (claimant seriously injured) has a demand exceeding the auto limit of $500k.

why: Excess exposure on a serious bodily injury lawsuit.

claim.fnol_text: Customer says our brushes ripped off his rear wiper and scratched the tailgate. He has photos and a dealer quote. Our attendant says the wiper was already loose.

why: Liability question on minor third-party damage; adjuster handles by phone and documents.

claim.fnol: Rock hit windshield on freeway. Chip, no crack. Photo taken.
claim.sys_note: glass vendor match: yes; repair eligible: yes

why: Routine windshield chip with photo via app.

claim.denuncia: Tamponamento in coda sulla tangenziale di Milano. Il veicolo dietro mi ha urtato. CID (constatazione amichevole) firmata da entrambi. Paraurti posteriore rotto. Nessun ferito.

why: Agreed-fault rear-end with signed joint report, photo and small estimate; routine direct settlement.

claim.fnol_text: Carpenter ants found in the wall of our sunroom. Exterminator treated. The wood studs are damaged and the contractor wants $6,000 to rebuild the wall. Is this covered?

why: Likely excluded insect damage; an adjuster decides coverage from the reports without needing to visit.

claim.fnol_text: Seasonal picker fell from an orchard ladder, hit his head, taken to hospital by ambulance. Conscious. CT scan pending.

why: Workplace head injury with hospital transport.

claim.fnol_text: Car was broken into, they smashed the passenger window and ripped out the dashboard to take the stereo/nav. Dash is torn apart, wires hanging. Photos attached.

why: Theft damage well photographed; an adjuster can write it from photos and a shop estimate without visiting.

claim.fnol_text: Sprinkler pipe froze and burst on the third floor over the weekend while the lodge was closed. Water ran down through 2nd and 1st floors, into the great room. Ceiling collapsed in two guest rooms.

why: Large multi-floor water loss with ceiling collapse needs inspection.

claim.fnol_text: Hi, I need to cancel my trip because of my new job start date. Can I get the $1,900 back?

why: An uncovered-looking reason with no documents needs an adjuster to review coverage and explain; not a formal dispute.

claim.fnol_text: Earthquake cracked our chimney, bricks fell into the yard. There are also new cracks in the plaster in 3 rooms. We have the earthquake endorsement.

why: Earthquake structural damage needs inspection.

claim.fnol_text: My son accidentally hit a golf ball through the neighbor's sunroom glass panel. Neighbor sent me the glazier's invoice and wants to be reimbursed.

why: Small but a third-party liability payment, which needs an adjuster to confirm liability with the claimant.

claim.fnol_text: I got rear ended. Car's fine mostly, small crack in bumper. The other driver said sorry, I said no worries. I've since had headaches and my doctor said mild concussion from the jolt.

why: Diagnosed concussion makes this bodily injury despite trivial car damage.

claim.fnol_text: Our scheduled painting was damaged when a shelf fell on it. Canvas is torn. Conservator has written a report and estimate. The painting is scheduled at $85,000; conservator says it will lose about 30% of value even after repair.

why: High-value fine art with a diminished-value claim needs a specialist unit, not a general desk adjuster.

claim.fnol_text: Rocky was limping, vet did an exam and x-ray, soft tissue sprain, prescribed anti-inflammatories.

why: Small routine vet invoice.

claim.fnol_text: Our van was broken into overnight in the yard. Tools stolen and the side door lock was punched. Tool list attached with approximate values. Police report pending.

why: Tool theft needs adjuster verification of values and coverage.

claim.fnol_text: Kitchen fire started in toaster oven. The kitchen is gutted, smoke damage all through the first floor, the ceiling above the kitchen is burned through to the bedroom above. We're at a hotel.

why: Major interior fire damage needs on-site inspection.

claim.notification: Car was clipped by a lorry on the M6. Nearside wing and door dented, mirror off. Lorry driver stopped, gave details. Car drivable. No one hurt. Photos from the hard shoulder.

why: Drivable car with photographed panel damage and a traceable third party; image-based estimate and recovery at the desk.

claim.fnol_text: Student says she hurt her lower back in a class when the instructor adjusted her pose. She's seeing a chiropractor and wants the studio to pay.

why: Third-party bodily injury claim.

claim.fnol_text: Car rolled out of the driveway (parking brake failed) into the street and hit the curb and a tree. Front end damage, bumper hanging, hood crumpled, fluid leaking.

why: Heavy front-end damage with leaking fluids, no photos: needs appraisal.

claim.fnol_text: My flight from Cape Town to Joburg was cancelled due to weather, stayed overnight at the airport hotel. Airline letter + hotel + meal receipts.

why: Small travel delay expenses with documentation.

claim.fnol_text: Transformer failure caused a fire in the electrical room. Plant has no power. Fire contained to that room by sprinklers, but water in the adjacent production area. Molding machines may have water damage.

why: Industrial fire and water damage to equipment needs on-site inspection.

claim.fnol_text: A branch came down on the car port roof in wind. Put a small dent in the aluminum roof panel. Photo attached. Not a big deal, just want it straightened.

why: Tiny wind damage with photo.

claim.fnol_text: My Tesla-type EV was flooded on the street during the storm. Water was up over the wheels. It says battery fault now. EV value about $62k. It's at the service center.

why: Flooded vehicle needs inspection; at ~$62k it's not the high-value total loss the specialist unit takes.

claim.fnol_text: Patient alleges nerve damage after a wisdom tooth extraction. Received a letter from her attorney requesting records.

why: Malpractice injury allegation with attorney involvement.

claim.fnol: Power surge killed the fridge. Technician report says compressor board burnt out from surge. Fridge 3 yrs old, replacement quote attached, plus food spoilage.

why: Surge claim with cause-of-loss and replacement value to review from documents.

claim.fnol_text: Gravel truck dropped stones on the highway, several small chips on hood and a chip in the windshield. Photos attached. Just want the windshield chip fixed for now.

why: Only the glass chip is claimed; hood paint chips are mentioned but not claimed.

claim.fnol_text: Adjuster offered $7,200 for the water damage. My contractor's estimate is $19,800. I reject the offer. Your adjuster ignored the cabinets. I want someone else to look at it.

why: A scope disagreement asking for a re-inspection is resolved by sending someone to look; no lawyer, appraisal or coverage denial is involved.

claim.fnol_text: Hi. The storm last night knocked our satellite dish off the roof. It's hanging by the cable. A couple of shingles came off with it. Photos attached, roofer says $350 to reattach and patch.

why: Small wind damage with photos and quote.

claim.fnol_text: Hit a pedestrian in a crosswalk at low speed while turning right. She fell and was taken by ambulance. Police on scene. I'm very shaken.

why: Pedestrian injury.

claim.fnol_text: Ammonia refrigeration leak in the freezer plant. Plant evacuated, HAZMAT on site. Product in the freezers may be contaminated. No injuries per plant manager.

why: Plant contamination and equipment loss need on-site inspection.

claim.fnol_text: Mi hija se cayó en la piscina del hotel en Orlando y se abrió la barbilla. Urgencias, 5 puntos. Factura del hospital adjunta, pagamos 1.450 USD.

why: The claim pays for treatment of a person's injury (stitches after a fall), which is bodily injury even on the insured's own travel policy.

claim.fnol_text: Contractor's estimate attached for replacing our kitchen floor after the dishwasher leak. Photos attached. Floor is vinyl plank, about 180 sq ft, and some of the planks were lifting. Plumber fixed the leak same day.

why: Documented contained water loss with an estimate to review.

claim.fnol_text: Kitten Nori was spayed. We have the wellness plan which covers spay/neuter up to $250.

why: Routine wellness benefit with invoice.

claim.fnol_text: Hygienist stuck her finger with a used needle. Followed exposure protocol, baseline bloodwork done. No symptoms.

why: A needlestick with exposure testing is a workplace bodily injury claim, even though the bill is small.

claim.fnol_text: My daughter backed my car into a pole at school. Rear bumper and hatch dented. Photos attached. Body shop estimate attached. No one else involved.

why: Moderate single-vehicle damage with photos and estimate; adjuster reviews the estimate.

claim.fnol_text: Our well pump died and the house has no water. Pump guy says lightning. Needs new pump and some wiring.

why: Cause-of-loss question (lightning vs wear) on a modest claim that documents can resolve.

claim.fnol: Constat amiable rempli. L'autre conducteur m'a accroché en reculant dans un stationnement à Laval. Pare-chocs avant rayé. Aucun blessé.

why: Direct compensation with a completed joint report and small photographed damage; fault is set by the form.

claim.fnol_text: A delivery truck backed into our loading dock and bent the overhead door. Door won't close. Truck company admits it. Door company quote attached.

why: Documented damage with a clear third party for recovery.

claim.fnol_text: A truck hauling a trailer swerved and took out our brick mailbox, part of the brick front wall of the yard, and hit the corner of the garage. Garage corner bricks are cracked and pushed in.

why: Impact to the garage structure needs inspection.

claim.fnol_text: Bought a new car 3 weeks ago, a Range-Rover-class SUV ($148k). Someone ran a red light and T-boned it, frame is bent. Dealer says it's likely a total. I was fine, the other driver was fine.

why: Likely total loss of a very high-value vehicle routes to the specialist unit even without injuries.

claim.fnol_text: I dropped my camera in a river in Iceland. Water damaged, won't turn on. Repair shop says not economical to repair. Receipt from 2023 attached.

why: Single accidental damage item with repair note and receipt.

claim.fnol_text: A pipe inside the bathroom wall has been leaking slowly. We noticed the tiles falling off the shower wall. When the plumber opened it up, the wood studs behind are black and crumbly and the floor under the tub is soft.

why: Long-term hidden leak with rot needs inspection to scope and decide coverage.

claim.fnol_text: A vendor's canopy blew over in the wind and hit a shopper's parked car. Dent in the roof and a cracked windshield. Shopper sent photos and asked for our insurance.

why: Third-party property damage with a possible other insurer; adjuster work by phone and documents.

claim.fnol_text: Got hit at an intersection, the other guy ran the red. My car's front end is smashed, airbags deployed. I went to urgent care the next day for chest pain, they said it was bruising from the seatbelt.

why: Injury treated at urgent care.

claim.fnol_text: Upstairs neighbor's tub overflowed and water came through my ceiling onto my bed and desk. My mattress is ruined and my laptop got wet. Landlord is handling the ceiling. Photos and receipts attached.

why: Small contents claim but with a clear responsible neighbor for subrogation; adjuster work, no inspection.

claim.fnol_text: Hail. Windows on the west side broken (4 of them) and the skylight cracked. Rain got in through the skylight onto the hardwood. Also the roof probably. We haven't been up there.

why: Multiple hail damages including uninspected roof need inspection.

claim.fnol_text: Our dog bit a man in the park and the man is now claiming for his hospital visit and time off work. His lawyer sent a letter.
claim.notes: third-party liability section on pet policy

why: Third-party injury with legal representation.

claim.fnol_text: Front bumper damaged in an accident, parking lot. Low speed. Photos + estimate attached. The other driver had a baby in the back, everyone fine, the mother checked him right away and he was sleeping through it.

why: Two-party low-speed collision with explicit no-injuries; the baby is mentioned but nobody was hurt, so standard desk handling.

claim.fnol_text: Someone stole the catalytic converter from my car in the driveway. Police report attached. Mechanic's invoice for replacement attached.

why: Common, well-documented theft repair already completed with invoice and police report.

claim.fnol_text: Roof leak over the dining hall after heavy rain. Some ceiling tiles fell. Maintenance says the membrane has multiple splits. Residents moved to another room for meals.

why: Commercial roof failure of unknown extent needs inspection.

claim.fnol_text: My backpack was stolen from the hostel locker room in Hanoi. Contained clothes and a Kindle. Hostel wrote a note, police report in Vietnamese attached.

why: Small theft with police report.

claim.fnol_text: Our tree fell on the neighbor's house during the storm, went through their roof. Nobody hurt. Neighbor says their insurance is handling it but they'll come after us because they told us last year the tree was dying.

why: Potential subrogation against our insured for negligence; an adjuster assesses liability by documents. No suit or lawyer yet.

claim.fnol_text: Hello, I'm writing about the storm on Saturday. I was at my daughter's and when I came back there was water on the floor of the sunroom, the sunroom is the addition on the back that my late husband built in the 90s. The roof of it has those plastic panels and one of them is cracked and I think a branch hit it because there are leaves and a branch on top. The floor is tile so I mopped it up. Nothing else was wet except a rug which I threw out, it was old anyway. My neighbor Frank took some pictures from his ladder for me and I've attached them. I called a man from the paper, Hollister Home Repair, and he wrote me a price for the panel. I don't want to make a fuss I just want the panel fixed before winter. Thank you.

why: Long, rambling notice but the loss is one cracked panel with photos and a small quote.

claim.fnol_text: Our stretch limo was rear-ended at a light by a pickup. Rear bumper and trunk lid damaged. Car drivable. Passengers (a wedding party) were inside; the bride's mother says her neck hurts and she wants to see a doctor.

why: Passenger reports neck pain after a collision.

claim.fnol_text: Mice chewed through wiring in my engine bay while the car sat for the winter. Check engine light and it won't start. Dealer found chewed harness, estimate attached. Photos of the nest too.

why: Rodent damage claim with estimate; adjuster reviews coverage and cost.

claim.fnol_text: Sinkhole opened up in the backyard near the pool deck. The pool deck has cracked and the pool itself seems to be leaning a bit. We're in Hillsborough County.

why: Possible sinkhole activity near structures needs a field inspection.

claim.fnol_text: Cancelled cruise because I was diagnosed with pneumonia. Doctor's note, cruise line cancellation invoice with the penalty, and my original booking attached.

why: Cancellation with medical proof needing adjuster review.

claim.fnol_text: My rear windshield shattered on its own in the cold. Glass company replaced it. Invoice attached.

why: Completed glass replacement, invoice.

claim.fnol_text: Hail storm went through the lot. About 140 vehicles on the lot have hail damage, plus the showroom's skylights are cracked.

why: Mass hail loss to inventory and building needs on-site inspection.

claim.fnol_text: Luna the cat was hit by a car. Emergency vet, x-rays, pelvic fracture, 2 nights of care, they're managing without surgery. Invoice attached.

why: An injured animal is not bodily injury; a larger emergency bill that a desk adjuster reviews.

claim.fnol_text: Smoke alarm went off, found a small fire in the bathroom exhaust fan. It melted the fan housing and there's a black mark on the ceiling around it. Electrician replaced the fan and said the wiring in the attic above is fine. Photos + invoice + painter's quote.

why: A small, contained fire already checked by an electrician; documents suffice, but a fire loss still gets an adjuster's look.

claim.fnol_text: I drove through a flooded underpass and the engine died. Tow truck took it to the dealer. They say water got into the engine through the air intake, engine may be hydrolocked. 2017 Ford Focus.

why: Flooded engine on a low-value car needs appraisal for repair vs total.

claim.fnol_text: A toddler got a finger pinched in a door at our center. Parents took him to the ER, finger is broken.

why: Child injured at the insured's premises.

claim.fnol_text: Mijn fiets is gestolen bij het station in Utrecht. Aangifte gedaan bij de politie. Aankoopbon bijgevoegd.

why: Single stolen bike with police report and receipt; the higher e-bike price does not change routine handling.

claim.fnol_text: The car got hail damaged in the parking lot at work, about 20 small dings on the hood and roof. No glass damage. Photos attached. PDR shop estimate attached.

why: Hail dents documented with photos and a PDR estimate; adjuster reviews at the desk, unlike widespread undocumented hail.

claim.fnol_text: Yard worker's hand was caught in a conveyor belt. Partial amputation of the index finger. Taken to trauma center. OSHA notified.

why: Serious workplace injury.

claim.fnol_text: Big storm. A tree limb came down on our garage roof. There's a hole about 3 feet wide and the rafters under it are broken. Tarped for now.

why: Structural roof damage with broken rafters needs inspection.

claim.fnol_text: Hotel safe in Marrakech was broken into, passport and some cash missing. Police report attached. Replacement passport fee receipt.

why: Small documented travel theft.

claim.fnol_text: Kitchen hood fire. Suppression system discharged. Kitchen is covered in the chemical foam and the hood ductwork is scorched. Fire department says the fire may have gotten into the roof penetration.

why: Commercial kitchen fire possibly into the roof needs inspection.

claim.fnol_text: Hit a deer. Front bumper cracked, one headlight out. It's a 2008 Corolla. Car drives fine. No photos yet.

why: No photos or estimate at all, so someone must see the car, even though damage sounds moderate.

claim.fnol_text: Your adjuster denied our foundation claim citing the earth movement exclusion. Our engineer says it was caused by a plumbing leak, which you cover. We want this re-reviewed. Engineer report attached. We've filed a complaint with the Department of Insurance.

why: Coverage dispute with a regulator complaint.

claim.fnol_text: Buster had a skin infection, antibiotics and medicated shampoo. Receipt attached.

why: Small routine vet invoice.

claim.fnol_text: Our worker's squeegee bucket fell from the 3rd floor and dented a customer's car parked below. Customer sent a photo and wants $900 for the repair.

why: Third-party property damage with liability to confirm; handled by phone and documents.

claim.fnol: Car stolen from Sydney airport long-term parking. Not recovered. 2019 Toyota Corolla.

why: Unrecovered theft of an ordinary car; document review and valuation.

claim.fnol_text: My son was mowing the lawn and a rock flew out and broke our own sliding door glass. Replacement quote attached, photos.

why: Small glass replacement with photo and quote.

claim.fnol_text: Other driver merged into me. I'm fine. Minor scratches on my rear door. BUT the other driver is now saying I hit her, and her lawyer called me today saying she has a back injury.

why: Represented third party claiming bodily injury.

claim.fnol_text: Burst pipe flooded the roastery floor, 2 inches of water throughout. The green coffee sacks on pallets got wet at the bottom, maybe 30 bags. Roaster sits on the floor, unsure if motor got wet.

why: Water throughout a production floor affecting stock and equipment needs inspection.
